16.28.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
ityāścaryamidaṃ deva tvattaḥ sarvaṃ mayā śrutam ..
mahimānaṃ maheśasya vistareṇa samudbhavam ..
sāṃprataṃ somanāthasya yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 1 ..
16.28.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
इत्याश्चर्यमिदं देव त्वत्तः सर्वं मया श्रुतम् ..
महिमानं महेशस्य विस्तरेण समुद्भवम् ..
सांप्रतं सोमनाथस्य यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 1 ..
16.28.m: The Goddess said: / All this wonder, O Lord, has been heard by me from you, / the greatness originating from Maheśa in full detail. / Now you ought to tell properly of Somanātha: 1.

16.28.s:
vidhinā kena dṛśyosau yātrā kāryā kathaṃ nṛbhiḥ ..
kasminkāle mahādeva niyamāścaiva kīdṛśāḥ .. 2 .. ..
16.28.d:
विधिना केन दृश्योसौ यात्रा कार्या कथं नृभिः ..
कस्मिन्काले महादेव नियमाश्चैव कीदृशाः .. 2 .. ..
16.28.m: By what rite is he to be visited? How should the pilgrimage be performed by men? / At what time, O Mahādeva, and what are the observances? 2.

16.28.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
hemante śiśire vāpi vasante vātha bhāmini ..
yadā ca jāyate cittaṃ vittaṃ vā parva vā bhavet .. 3 ..
16.28.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
हेमन्ते शिशिरे वापि वसन्ते वाथ भामिनि ..
यदा च जायते चित्तं वित्तं वा पर्व वा भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.28.m: Īśvara said: / In late autumn, winter, or spring, O radiant lady, / and whenever the inclination arises, or funds are available, or a festival day occurs, 3.

16.28.s:
tadaiva yātrā karttavyā bhāvastatraiva kāraṇam ..
kṛtvā tu niyamaṃ kaṃcitsvagṛhe varavarṇini .. 4 ..
16.28.d:
तदैव यात्रा कर्त्तव्या भावस्तत्रैव कारणम् ..
कृत्वा तु नियमं कंचित्स्वगृहे वरवर्णिनि .. 4 ..
16.28.m: just then the pilgrimage should be undertaken; the inner attitude alone is the cause there. / Having undertaken some observance in his own house, O woman of excellent complexion, 4.

16.28.s:
praṇamya manasā rudraṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi ..
sthānaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vāgyataḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 5 ..
16.28.d:
प्रणम्य मनसा रुद्रं कृत्वा श्राद्धं यथाविधि ..
स्थानं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा वाग्यतः सुसमाहितः .. 5 ..
16.28.m: bowing mentally to Rudra and performing a śrāddha according to the rules, / circumambulating the home, silent and well-composed, 5.

16.28.s:
niyato niyatāhāro gaccheccaiva tataḥ pathi ..
kāmakrodhau parityajya lobhamohau tathaiva ca .. 6 ..
16.28.d:
नियतो नियताहारो गच्छेच्चैव ततः पथि ..
कामक्रोधौ परित्यज्य लोभमोहौ तथैव च .. 6 ..
16.28.m: self-restrained and regulated in diet, one should then set out on the path, / abandoning desire and anger, as well as greed and delusion, 6.

16.28.s:
īrṣyāmatsaralaulyaṃ ca yātrā kāryā tato nṛbhiḥ ..
tīrthānugamanaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñebhyo'pi viśiṣyate .. 7 ..
16.28.d:
ईर्ष्यामत्सरलौल्यं च यात्रा कार्या ततो नृभिः ..
तीर्थानुगमनं पुण्यं यज्ञेभ्योऽपि विशिष्यते .. 7 ..
16.28.m: envy, malice, and fickle longing—thus should the pilgrimage be performed by men. / The pious journey to a sacred ford is superior even to sacrifices. 7.

16.28.s:
agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca iṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ ..
tattatphalamavāpnoti tīrthānugamanena yat .. 8 ..
16.28.d:
अग्निष्टोमादियज्ञैश्च इष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः ..
तत्तत्फलमवाप्नोति तीर्थानुगमनेन यत् .. 8 ..
16.28.m: Whatever fruit one attains through sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma / that are performed with generous priestly gifts, that very fruit one obtains through the journey to a sacred ford. 8.

16.28.s:
kaleryugaṃ mahāghoraṃ prāpya pāpasamanvitam ..
nānyenā'sminnupāyena dharmmaḥ svargaśca labhyate ..
vinā yātrāṃ mahādevi someśasya na saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
16.28.d:
कलेर्युगं महाघोरं प्राप्य पापसमन्वितम् ..
नान्येनाऽस्मिन्नुपायेन धर्म्मः स्वर्गश्च लभ्यते ..
विना यात्रां महादेवि सोमेशस्य न संशयः .. 9 ..
16.28.m: Having reached the terrible Kali age full of sin, / righteousness and heaven are attained in this [age] by no other means / except for a pilgrimage to Someśa, O great goddess; there is no doubt. 9.

16.28.s:
ye kurvaṃti narā yātrāṃ śuciśraddhāsamanvitāḥ ..
kalau yuge kṛtārthāste ye tvanye te nirarthakāḥ .. 7.1.28.10 ..
16.28.d:
ये कुर्वंति नरा यात्रां शुचिश्रद्धासमन्विताः ..
कलौ युगे कृतार्थास्ते ये त्वन्ये ते निरर्थकाः .. 7.1.28.10 ..
16.28.m: The men who undertake the pilgrimage endowed with purity and faith / are fulfilled in purpose in the Kali age, while those who do otherwise are in vain. 10.

16.28.s:
yathāmahodadhestulyo na cānyo'sti jalāśayaḥ ..
tathā prābhāsikātkṣetrātsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na vidyate .. 11 ..
16.28.d:
यथामहोदधेस्तुल्यो न चान्योऽस्ति जलाशयः ..
तथा प्राभासिकात्क्षेत्रात्समं तीर्थं न विद्यते .. 11 ..
16.28.m: Just as there is no reservoir of water equal to the great ocean, / so there is no sacred ford equal to the field of Prabhāsa. 11.

16.28.s:
anupoṣya trirātrāṇi tīrthānyanabhigamya ca ..
adattvā kāṃcanaṃ gāśca daridronāma jāyate .. 12 ..
16.28.d:
अनुपोष्य त्रिरात्राणि तीर्थान्यनभिगम्य च ..
अदत्त्वा कांचनं गाश्च दरिद्रोनाम जायते .. 12 ..
16.28.m: Without fasting for three nights, without visiting sacred fords, / and without giving gold and cows, a man is born poor. 12.

16.28.s:
yanyagamyāni tīrthāni durgāṇi viṣamāṇi ca ..
manasā tāni gamyāni sarvatīrthagatīpsunā .. 13 ..
16.28.d:
यन्यगम्यानि तीर्थानि दुर्गाणि विषमाणि च ..
मनसा तानि गम्यानि सर्वतीर्थगतीप्सुना .. 13 ..
16.28.m: Sacred fords that are inaccessible, difficult, and impassable / should be reached with the mind by one who desires the goal of all sacred fords. 13.

16.28.s:
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam ..
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .. 14 ..
16.28.d:
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश्चैव सुसंयतम् ..
विद्या तपश्च कीर्तिश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .. 14 ..
16.28.m: He whose hands, feet, and mind are well controlled, / and who possesses learning, austerity, and renown, enjoys the fruit of a sacred ford. 14.

16.28.s:
niyato niyatāhāraḥ snāna. jāpyaparāyaṇaḥ ..
vratopavāsanirataḥ sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .. 15 ..
16.28.d:
नियतो नियताहारः स्नान. जाप्यपरायणः ..
व्रतोपवासनिरतः स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .. 15 ..
16.28.m: Self-restrained, regulated in diet, devoted to ritual bathing and muttered prayer, / intent on vows and fasts, he enjoys the fruit of a sacred ford. 15.

16.28.s:
akrodhanaśca deveśi satyaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ ..
ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .. 16 ..
16.28.d:
अक्रोधनश्च देवेशि सत्यशीलो दृढव्रतः ..
आत्मोपमश्च भूतेषु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .. 16 ..
16.28.m: Free from anger, O goddess of gods, truthful in character, firm in vows, / and regarding all beings as oneself, he enjoys the fruit of a sacred ford. 16.

16.28.s:
kurukṣetrāditīrthāni rathagamyāni yāni tu ..
tānyeva brāhmaṇo yāyādānadoṣo na teṣu vai .. 17 ..
16.28.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रादितीर्थानि रथगम्यानि यानि तु ..
तान्येव ब्राह्मणो यायादानदोषो न तेषु वै .. 17 ..
16.28.m: As for sacred fords such as Kurukṣetra that can be reached by chariot, / a brahmin may go to those alone; no carriage-fault attaches to them. 17.

16.28.s:
ye sādhavo dhanopetāstīrthānāṃ smaraṇe ratāḥ ..
tīrthe dānācca yogācca teṣāmabhyadhikaṃ phalam .. 18 ..
16.28.d:
ये साधवो धनोपेतास्तीर्थानां स्मरणे रताः ..
तीर्थे दानाच्च योगाच्च तेषामभ्यधिकं फलम् .. 18 ..
16.28.m: Those virtuous people endowed with wealth who are devoted to the remembrance of sacred fords, / through gift and spiritual union at a sacred ford, obtain a superior fruit. 18.

16.28.s:
ye daridrā dhanairhīnāstīrthānugamaneratāḥ..
teṣāṃ yajñaphalāvāptirvināpi dhanasaṃcayaiḥ ..19..
16.28.d:
ये दरिद्रा धनैर्हीनास्तीर्थानुगमनेरताः..
तेषां यज्ञफलावाप्तिर्विनापि धनसंचयैः ..19..
16.28.m: Those who are poor and destitute of wealth, [yet] devoted to traveling to a sacred ford, / obtain the fruit of a sacrifice even without accumulations of wealth. 19.

16.28.s:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ sarvāśramanivāsinām ..
tīrthaṃ tu phaladaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 7.1.28.20 ..
16.28.d:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां सर्वाश्रमनिवासिनाम् ..
तीर्थं तु फलदं ज्ञेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 7.1.28.20 ..
16.28.m: For all classes and for residents of all stages of life, / a sacred ford is known to grant fruit; no doubt should be entertained here.

16.28.s:
kāryāṃtareṇa yo gatvā snānaṃ tīrthe samācaret ..
na ca yātrāphalaṃ tasya snānamātraṃ phalaṃ bhavet .. 21 ..
16.28.d:
कार्यांतरेण यो गत्वा स्नानं तीर्थे समाचरेत् ..
न च यात्राफलं तस्य स्नानमात्रं फलं भवेत् .. 21 ..
16.28.m: He who goes on account of another business and performs ritual ablution at a sacred ford / does not obtain the fruit of a pilgrimage; his fruit is only that of the ritual ablution.

16.28.s:
tīrthānugamanaṃ padbhyāṃ tapaḥparamihocyate ..
tadeva kṛtvā yānena snānamātraphalaṃ labhet .. 22 ..
16.28.d:
तीर्थानुगमनं पद्भ्यां तपःपरमिहोच्यते ..
तदेव कृत्वा यानेन स्नानमात्रफलं लभेत् .. 22 ..
16.28.m: Going on foot to a sacred ford is called supreme austerity in this world; / but having done that with a conveyance, one would obtain only the fruit of ritual ablution.

16.28.s:
yasyānyaḥ kurute śaktyā tīrthayātrāṃ tatheśvari ..
svakīyadravyayānābhyāṃ phalaṃ tasya caturguṇam .. 23 ..
16.28.d:
यस्यान्यः कुरुते शक्त्या तीर्थयात्रां तथेश्वरि ..
स्वकीयद्रव्ययानाभ्यां फलं तस्य चतुर्गुणम् .. 23 ..
16.28.m: When one enables another according to his ability to make a pilgrimage to a sacred ford, O goddess, / with his own wealth and conveyance, his fruit is fourfold.

16.28.s:
tīrthānugamanaṃ kṛtvā bhikṣāhārā jiteṃdriyāḥ..
prāpnuvaṃti mahādevi tīrthe daśaguṇaṃ phalam .. 24 ..
16.28.d:
तीर्थानुगमनं कृत्वा भिक्षाहारा जितेंद्रियाः..
प्राप्नुवंति महादेवि तीर्थे दशगुणं फलम् .. 24 ..
16.28.m: Those who, having journeyed to a sacred ford, subsist on alms with controlled senses, / obtain a tenfold fruit at the sacred ford, O great goddess.

16.28.s:
chatropānadvihīnastu bhikṣāśī vijiteṃdriyaḥ ..
mahāpātakajairghorairvipraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 25 ..
16.28.d:
छत्रोपानद्विहीनस्तु भिक्षाशी विजितेंद्रियः ..
महापातकजैर्घोरैर्विप्रः पापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 25 ..
16.28.m: Without umbrella and shoes, eating alms, with senses fully subdued, / a brahmin is freed from dreadful sins born of mortal sins.

16.28.s:
na bhaikṣaṃ parapākaṃ tu na ca bhaikṣyaṃ pratigraham ..
somapānasamaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ tasmādbhaikṣaṃ samācaret .. 26 ..
16.28.d:
न भैक्षं परपाकं तु न च भैक्ष्यं प्रतिग्रहम् ..
सोमपानसमं भैक्ष्यं तस्माद्भैक्षं समाचरेत् .. 26 ..
16.28.m: Alms are not food cooked by another, nor are alms an acceptance of gifts; / alms are equal to the drinking of Soma; therefore one should subsist on alms.

16.28.s:
loke'smindvividhaṃ tīrthaṃ svaccha ndairnirmmitaṃ tathā ..
svayaṃbhūtaṃ prabhāsādyaṃ nirmitaṃ daivataiḥ kṛtam .. 27 ..
16.28.d:
लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधं तीर्थं स्वच्छ न्दैर्निर्म्मितं तथा ..
स्वयंभूतं प्रभासाद्यं निर्मितं दैवतैः कृतम् .. 27 ..
16.28.m: In this world a sacred ford is twofold: created naturally [or] made; / self-manifest, such as Prabhāsa and others, and made, which is fashioned by the gods.

16.28.s:
svayaṃbhūte mahātīrthe svabhāve ca mahattare ..
tasmiṃstīrthe pratigṛhya kṛtāḥ sarve pratigrahāḥ .. 28 ..
16.28.d:
स्वयंभूते महातीर्थे स्वभावे च महत्तरे ..
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे प्रतिगृह्य कृताः सर्वे प्रतिग्रहाः .. 28 ..
16.28.m: In a self-manifest great sacred ford, which by its own nature is greater, / if one accepts [gifts], all forms of gift-acceptance have been committed in that sacred ford.

16.28.s:
pratigrahanivṛttasya yātrādaśaguṇaṃ phalam ..
tena dattāni dānāni yajñairdevāḥ sutarpitāḥ .. 29 ..
16.28.d:
प्रतिग्रहनिवृत्तस्य यात्रादशगुणं फलम् ..
तेन दत्तानि दानानि यज्ञैर्देवाः सुतर्पिताः .. 29 ..
16.28.m: For one who abstains from accepting gifts, the fruit of the pilgrimage is tenfold; / by him gifts are given, and the gods are well gratified through sacrifices,

16.28.s:
yena kṣetraṃ samāsādya nivṛttiḥ paramā kṛtā ..
vastulaulyāddhi yaḥ kṣetre pratigraharucistathā .. 7.1.28.30 ..
16.28.d:
येन क्षेत्रं समासाद्य निवृत्तिः परमा कृता ..
वस्तुलौल्याद्धि यः क्षेत्रे प्रतिग्रहरुचिस्तथा .. 7.1.28.30 ..
16.28.m: by whom, having reached the sacred field, supreme abstention has been observed. / But he who, out of greed for material things in the sacred field, takes pleasure in accepting gifts—

16.28.s:
naiva tasya paroloko nāyaṃ loko durātmanaḥ ..
atha cetpratigṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo vṛttidurbalaḥ ..
daśāṃśamarjitāddadyādevaṃ tatra na hīyate .. 31 ..
16.28.d:
नैव तस्य परोलोको नायं लोको दुरात्मनः ..
अथ चेत्प्रतिगृह्णाति ब्राह्मणो वृत्तिदुर्बलः ..
दशांशमर्जिताद्दद्यादेवं तत्र न हीयते .. 31 ..
16.28.m: for that wicked soul there is neither the other world nor this world. / But if a brahmin, feeble in livelihood, accepts a gift, / he should give a tenth part of what is earned; thus he does not fall there.

16.28.s:
vipraveṣaṃ samāsthāya śūdro bhūtvā pratigraham ..
tṛṇakāṣṭhasamaṃ vāpi pratigṛhya patatyadhaḥ .. 32 ..
16.28.d:
विप्रवेषं समास्थाय शूद्रो भूत्वा प्रतिग्रहम् ..
तृणकाष्ठसमं वापि प्रतिगृह्य पतत्यधः .. 32 ..
16.28.m: A śūdra who adopts the guise of a brahmin and, having accepted a gift / even as small as grass or wood, falls into the depths—

16.28.s:
kumbhīpākādikeṣvevaṃ mahānarakakoṭiṣu ..
yāvadiṃdrasahasrāṇi caturddaśa varānane ..33..
16.28.d:
कुम्भीपाकादिकेष्वेवं महानरककोटिषु ..
यावदिंद्रसहस्राणि चतुर्द्दश वरानने ..33..
16.28.m: into Kumbhīpāka and the like, among crores of great hells, / for the duration of fourteen Indras, O fair-faced lady.

16.28.s:
tasmānnaiva pratigrāhyaṃ kimanyairbrāhmaṇairapi ..
dviprakārasya tīrthasya kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca .. 34 ..
16.28.d:
तस्मान्नैव प्रतिग्राह्यं किमन्यैर्ब्राह्मणैरपि ..
द्विप्रकारस्य तीर्थस्य कृतस्याप्यकृतस्य च .. 34 ..
16.28.m: Therefore, gifts should certainly not be accepted, how much less by other brahmins! / In a sacred ford of either kind, whether made or unmade,

16.28.s:
svakīyabhāvasaṃyuktaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ phalamaśnute ..
labhate ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ sa yaḥ parānnena gacchati .. 35 ..
16.28.d:
स्वकीयभावसंयुक्तः संपूर्णं फलमश्नुते ..
लभते षोडशांशं स यः परान्नेन गच्छति .. 35 ..
16.28.m: endowed with one's own proper disposition, one enjoys the full fruit. / He who travels on another's food obtains a sixteenth part.

16.28.s:
aśaktasya tathāṃdhasya paṃgoryāyāvarasya ca ..
vihitaṃ kāraṇāyānamacchidre brāhmaṇe kutaḥ .. 36 ..
16.28.d:
अशक्तस्य तथांधस्य पंगोर्यायावरस्य च ..
विहितं कारणायानमच्छिद्रे ब्राह्मणे कुतः .. 36 ..
16.28.m: For the disabled, for the blind, for the lame, and for the wandering ascetic, / travel by conveyance for a valid reason is prescribed; whence [could it be allowed] for an unblemished brahmin?

16.28.s:
snānakhādanapānaiśca voḍhṛbhyastīrthasevakaḥ ..
dadatsakalamāpnoti phalaṃ tīrthasamudbhavam .. 37 ..
16.28.d:
स्नानखादनपानैश्च वोढृभ्यस्तीर्थसेवकः ..
ददत्सकलमाप्नोति फलं तीर्थसमुद्भवम् .. 37 ..
16.28.m: A pilgrim of a sacred ford who provides ritual ablution, food, and drink / to his carriers attains the complete fruit arising from the sacred ford.

16.28.s:
na ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ yatnena labdhārthaṃ yadi yacchati ..
paṃcamāṃśamatho vāpi dadyāttatra dvijātiṣu .. 38 ..
16.28.d:
न षोडशांशं यत्नेन लब्धार्थं यदि यच्छति ..
पंचमांशमथो वापि दद्यात्तत्र द्विजातिषु .. 38 ..
16.28.m: If with effort he does not give a sixteenth part of his acquired wealth, / he should give even a fifth part among the twice-born there.

16.28.s:
devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca mātāpitrośca kāmataḥ ..
puṇyadaḥ samavāpnoti tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam .. 39 ..
16.28.d:
देवतानां गुरूणां च मातापित्रोश्च कामतः ..
पुण्यदः समवाप्नोति तदेवाष्टगुणं फलम् .. 39 ..
16.28.m: Bestowing merit willingly on deities, gurus, / and parents, he obtains eightfold that very fruit.

16.28.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam ..
puṇyaṃ deyaṃ tu sarvatra nāpuṇyaṃ dīyate kvacit .. 7.1.28.40 ..
16.28.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् ..
पुण्यं देयं तु सर्वत्र नापुण्यं दीयते क्वचित् .. 7.1.28.40 ..
16.28.m: Ritual ablution, gifting, silent prayer, burnt offering, Vedic study, worship of deities— / merit should be given everywhere; demerit is never given anywhere.

16.28.s:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tīrthe bhrātaraṃ suhṛdaṃ gurum ..
yamuddiśya nimajjeta dvādaśāṃśaṃ labheta saḥ .. 41 ..
16.28.d:
पितरं मातरं तीर्थे भ्रातरं सुहृदं गुरुम् ..
यमुद्दिश्य निमज्जेत द्वादशांशं लभेत सः .. 41 ..
16.28.m: A father, a mother, a brother, a friend, or a guru— / designating whom one plunges at a sacred ford, that person receives a twelfth part.

16.28.s:
kuśaistu pratimāṃ kṛtvā tīrthavāriṣu majjayet ..
yamuddiśya mahādevi aṣṭabhāgaṃ labheta saḥ .. 42 ..
16.28.d:
कुशैस्तु प्रतिमां कृत्वा तीर्थवारिषु मज्जयेत् ..
यमुद्दिश्य महादेवि अष्टभागं लभेत सः .. 42 ..
16.28.m: Having made an effigy out of kuśa grass, one should plunge it into the waters of the sacred ford; / designating whom, O great goddess, that person receives an eighth share.

16.28.s:
mahādānāni ye viprā gṛhṇanti jñānadurbalāḥ ..
vṛkṣāste dvijarūpeṇa jāyaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ .. 43 ..
16.28.d:
महादानानि ये विप्रा गृह्णन्ति ज्ञानदुर्बलाः ..
वृक्षास्ते द्विजरूपेण जायंते ब्रह्मराक्षसाः .. 43 ..
16.28.m: Those brahmins weak in wisdom who accept great gifts / become trees, [or] are born as brahmarākṣasas in the form of twice-borns.

16.28.s:
na vedabalamāśritya pratigraharucirbhavet ..
ajñānādvā pramādādvā dahate karma netarat .. 44 ..
16.28.d:
न वेदबलमाश्रित्य प्रतिग्रहरुचिर्भवेत् ..
अज्ञानाद्वा प्रमादाद्वा दहते कर्म नेतरत् .. 44 ..
16.28.m: One should not take pleasure in accepting gifts relying on the power of the Veda; / whether from ignorance or negligence, karma burns [him], nothing else.

16.28.s:
citikāṣṭhaṃ tu vai spṛṣṭvā yajñayūpaṃ tathaiva ca ..
vedavikrayiṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā snānameva vidhīyate .. 45 ..
16.28.d:
चितिकाष्ठं तु वै स्पृष्ट्वा यज्ञयूपं तथैव च ..
वेदविक्रयिणं स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानमेव विधीयते .. 45 ..
16.28.m: Having touched funeral wood, and likewise a sacrificial post, / or having touched one who sells the Veda, only a ritual ablution is prescribed.

16.28.s:
ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu ādeśaṃ tu dadāti yaḥ ..
dvāvetau pāpakarmāṇau pātālatalavāsinau .. 46 ..
16.28.d:
आदेशं पठते यस्तु आदेशं तु ददाति यः ..
द्वावेतौ पापकर्माणौ पातालतलवासिनौ .. 46 ..
16.28.m: He who recites a command, and he who gives a command— / both of these evildoers become dwellers in the depths of Pātāla.

16.28.s:
ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu saṃjighṛkṣuḥ pratigraham ..
tīrthe caiva viśeṣeṇa brahmaghnaḥ saiva netaraḥ ..
sthito vai nṛpaterdvāri na kuryādvedavikrayam .. 47 ..
16.28.d:
आदेशं पठते यस्तु संजिघृक्षुः प्रतिग्रहम् ..
तीर्थे चैव विशेषेण ब्रह्मघ्नः सैव नेतरः ..
स्थितो वै नृपतेर्द्वारि न कुर्याद्वेदविक्रयम् .. 47 ..
16.28.m: He who recites a command wishing to seize an acceptance of gifts, / especially at a sacred ford, is indeed a killer of a brahmin and none other. / Standing at a king's gate, one must not sell the Veda.

16.28.s:
hatvā gāvo varaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayīta dvijādhamaḥ ..
varaṃ jīvansamaṃ matsyairna kuryādvedavikrayam ..
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati .. 48 ..
16.28.d:
हत्वा गावो वरं मांसं भक्षयीत द्विजाधमः ..
वरं जीवन्समं मत्स्यैर्न कुर्याद्वेदविक्रयम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं न भूतं न भविष्यति .. 48 ..
16.28.m: Better that the lowest of the twice-born should kill cows and eat their flesh, / better that he should live like fish, than that he sell the Veda; / a sin equal to the murder of a brahmin has never been nor will ever be.

16.28.s:
varaṃ kuryācca taddevi na kuryādvedavikrayam ..
tīrthe caiva viśeṣeṇa mahākṣetre tathaiva ca .. 49 ..
16.28.d:
वरं कुर्याच्च तद्देवि न कुर्याद्वेदविक्रयम् ..
तीर्थे चैव विशेषेण महाक्षेत्रे तथैव च .. 49 ..
16.28.m: Better that he do even that, O goddess, than sell the Veda, / especially at a sacred ford, and likewise in a great sacred field.

16.28.s:
dīyamānaṃ tu vai dānaṃ yastyajettīrthasevakaḥ ..
tīrthaṃ karoti tīrthaṃ ca sa punāti ca pūrvajān .. 7.1.28.50 ..
16.28.d:
दीयमानं तु वै दानं यस्त्यजेत्तीर्थसेवकः ..
तीर्थं करोति तीर्थं च स पुनाति च पूर्वजान् .. 7.1.28.50 ..
16.28.m: A pilgrim of a sacred ford who refuses a gift being offered / makes the sacred ford truly sacred and purifies his ancestors.

16.28.s:
yadanyatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe tadyāti lāghavam..
na tīrthakṛtamanyatra kvacideva vyapohati .. 51 ..
16.28.d:
यदन्यत्र कृतं पापं तीर्थे तद्याति लाघवम्..
न तीर्थकृतमन्यत्र क्वचिदेव व्यपोहति .. 51 ..
16.28.m: A sin committed elsewhere is mitigated at a sacred ford; / a sin committed at a sacred ford cannot be removed anywhere at all.

16.28.s:
tailapātramivātmānaṃ yo rakṣettīrthasevakaḥ ..
sa tīrthaphalamaskannaṃ vipraḥ prāpnoti saṃyataḥ .. ... 52 ..
16.28.d:
तैलपात्रमिवात्मानं यो रक्षेत्तीर्थसेवकः ..
स तीर्थफलमस्कन्नं विप्रः प्राप्नोति संयतः .. ... 52 ..
16.28.m: A pilgrim of a sacred ford who guards himself like a vessel of oil— / that self-controlled brahmin obtains the unspilled fruit of the sacred ford.

16.28.s:
yasyayasyātti pakvānnamalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ..
tīrthagastasya tasyārdhaṃ snātasya viniyacchati .. 53 ..
16.28.d:
यस्ययस्यात्ति पक्वान्नमल्पं वा यदि वा बहु ..
तीर्थगस्तस्य तस्यार्धं स्नातस्य विनियच्छति .. 53 ..
16.28.m: Whosesoever cooked food he eats, whether little or much, / to that person he, having bathed while residing at the sacred ford, gives half [his fruit].

16.28.s:
yo na kliṣṭopi bhikṣeta brāhmaṇa stīrthasevakaḥ ..
satyavādī samādhisthaḥ sa tīrthasyopakārakaḥ .. 54..
16.28.d:
यो न क्लिष्टोपि भिक्षेत ब्राह्मण स्तीर्थसेवकः ..
सत्यवादी समाधिस्थः स तीर्थस्योपकारकः .. 54..
16.28.m: A brahmin pilgrim of a sacred ford who does not beg even when distressed, / truthful in speech, absorbed in contemplation, is a benefactor of the sacred ford.

16.28.s:
kṛte yuge puṣkarāṇi tretāyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā ..
dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ kalauyuge .. 55 ..
16.28.d:
कृते युगे पुष्कराणि त्रेतायां नैमिषं तथा ..
द्वापरे तु कुरुक्षेत्रं प्राभासिकं कलौयुगे .. 55 ..
16.28.m: In the Kṛta age it is Puṣkara, in the Tretā likewise Naimiṣa, / in the Dvāpara indeed Kurukṣetra, and in the Kali age Prabhāsa.

16.28.s:
tiṣṭhedyugasahasraṃtupādenaikena yaḥ pumān ..
prabhāsayātrāmeko vā samaṃ bhavati vā na vā .. 56 ..
16.28.d:
तिष्ठेद्युगसहस्रंतुपादेनैकेन यः पुमान् ..
प्रभासयात्रामेको वा समं भवति वा न वा .. 56 ..
16.28.m: A man who would stand on one foot for a thousand ages, / and one who makes a single pilgrimage to Prabhāsa—whether they are equal or not [is questioned].

16.28.s:
etatkṣetraṃ samāgatya madhyabhāge varānane ..
yānāni tu parityajya bhāvyaṃ pādacarairnaraiḥ..57..
16.28.d:
एतत्क्षेत्रं समागत्य मध्यभागे वरानने ..
यानानि तु परित्यज्य भाव्यं पादचरैर्नरैः..57..
16.28.m: Having arrived at this sacred field, O fair-faced lady, in its central region, / leaving behind conveyances, men must travel on foot.

16.28.s:
luṭhitvā loṭhanīṃ tatra luṭhitā yatra devatāḥ ..
tato nṛtyanhasangāyanbhūtvā kārpaṭikā kṛtiḥ ..
gacchetsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā cādau kaparddinam.. 58 ..
16.28.d:
लुठित्वा लोठनीं तत्र लुठिता यत्र देवताः ..
ततो नृत्यन्हसन्गायन्भूत्वा कार्पटिका कृतिः ..
गच्छेत्सोमेश्वरं देवं दृष्ट्वा चादौ कपर्द्दिनम्.. 58 ..
16.28.m: Having rolled on the Loṭhanī where the deities rolled, / then dancing, laughing, singing, assuming the attire of a pilgrim, / one should go to the god Someśvara, having first seen Kapardin.

16.28.s:
īdṛśaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthitaṃ someśvaronmukham ..
nityaṃ tuṣyaṃti pitaro garjaṃti ca pitā mahāḥ .. 59 ..
16.28.d:
ईदृशं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा स्थितं सोमेश्वरोन्मुखम् ..
नित्यं तुष्यंति पितरो गर्जंति च पिता महाः .. 59 ..
16.28.m: Seeing such a person standing turned toward Someśvara, / ancestors are constantly pleased, and grandfathers shout with joy:

16.28.s:
asmākaṃ vaṃśajo devaṃ prasthitastāraṇāya naḥ ..
gatvā someśvaraṃ devi kuryādvapanamāditaḥ .. 7.1.28.60 ..
16.28.d:
अस्माकं वंशजो देवं प्रस्थितस्तारणाय नः ..
गत्वा सोमेश्वरं देवि कुर्याद्वपनमादितः .. 7.1.28.60 ..
16.28.m: “Born in our lineage, he has set out toward the god to deliver us!” / Having gone to Someśvara, O goddess, one should first shave the head.

16.28.s:
tīrthopavāsaḥ karttavyo yathāvadvai nibodha me ..
nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti kratusamā gatiḥ ..61..
16.28.d:
तीर्थोपवासः कर्त्तव्यो यथावद्वै निबोध मे ..
नास्ति गंगासमं तीर्थं नास्ति क्रतुसमा गतिः ..61..
16.28.m: Fasting at the sacred ford should be observed properly; understand from me: / there is no sacred ford equal to Gaṅgā; there is no destination equal to a Vedic sacrifice.

16.28.s:
gāyatrīsadṛśaṃ jāpyaṃ homo vyāhṛtibhiḥ samaḥ ..
aṃtarjale tathā nāsti pāpaghnamaghamarṣaṇāt ..62..
16.28.d:
गायत्रीसदृशं जाप्यं होमो व्याहृतिभिः समः ..
अंतर्जले तथा नास्ति पापघ्नमघमर्षणात् ..62..
16.28.m: There is no recitation equal to the Gāyatrī, no fire oblation equal to [that with] the vyāhṛtis; / and in the water there is nothing that destroys sin equal to the Aghamarṣaṇa.

16.28.s:
ahiṃsāsadṛśaṃ puṇyaṃ dānātsaṃcayanaṃ param ..
tapaścānaśanānnāsti tathā tīrthaniṣevaṇāt ..63..
16.28.d:
अहिंसासदृशं पुण्यं दानात्संचयनं परम् ..
तपश्चानशनान्नास्ति तथा तीर्थनिषेवणात् ..63..
16.28.m: There is no merit equal to non-violence; giving is superior to accumulating; / there is no austerity equal to fasting, and likewise none equal to resorting to a sacred ford.

16.28.s:
tīrthopavāsāddeveśi adhikaṃ nāsti kiñcana ..
pāpānāṃ copaśamanaṃ satāmīpsitakārakam .. 64 ..
16.28.d:
तीर्थोपवासाद्देवेशि अधिकं नास्ति किञ्चन ..
पापानां चोपशमनं सतामीप्सितकारकम् .. 64 ..
16.28.m: O Queen of the gods, there is nothing greater than fasting at a sacred ford; / it pacifies sins and grants what the virtuous desire.

16.28.s:
upavāso vinirddiṣṭo viśeṣāddevatāśraye ..
brāhmaṇasya tvanaśanaṃ tapaḥ paramihocyate .. 65 ..
16.28.d:
उपवासो विनिर्द्दिष्टो विशेषाद्देवताश्रये ..
ब्राह्मणस्य त्वनशनं तपः परमिहोच्यते .. 65 ..
16.28.m: Fasting is especially prescribed in the sanctuary of a deity; / fasting is said to be the supreme austerity for a brahmin in this world.

16.28.s:
ṣaṣṭhakālāśanaṃ śūdre tapaḥ proktaṃ paraṃ budhaiḥ ..
varṇasaṃkarajātānāṃ dinamekaṃ prakīrtitam .. 66 ..
16.28.d:
षष्ठकालाशनं शूद्रे तपः प्रोक्तं परं बुधैः ..
वर्णसंकरजातानां दिनमेकं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 66 ..
16.28.m: Eating at the sixth mealtime is declared by the wise to be the supreme austerity for a śūdra; / for those born of mixed castes, [a fast of] one day is proclaimed.

16.28.s:
ṣaṣṭhakālātparaṃ śūdrastapaḥ kuryādyathā kvacit ..
rāṣṭrahānistadā jñeyā rājñaścopadravo mahān .. 67 ..
16.28.d:
षष्ठकालात्परं शूद्रस्तपः कुर्याद्यथा क्वचित् ..
राष्ट्रहानिस्तदा ज्ञेया राज्ञश्चोपद्रवो महान् .. 67 ..
16.28.m: If a śūdra should ever perform austerity beyond [eating at] the sixth mealtime, / ruin of the kingdom and great calamity for the king must then be understood [to follow].

16.28.s:
śūdrastu ṣaṣṭhakālāśī yathāśaktyā tapaścaret ..
na darbhānuddharecchūdro na pibetkāpilaṃ payaḥ .. 68 ..
16.28.d:
शूद्रस्तु षष्ठकालाशी यथाशक्त्या तपश्चरेत् ..
न दर्भानुद्धरेच्छूद्रो न पिबेत्कापिलं पयः .. 68 ..
16.28.m: A śūdra, eating at the sixth mealtime, should practice austerity according to his ability. / A śūdra must not gather darbha grass, nor drink the milk of a brown cow.

16.28.s:
madhyapatre na bhuñjīta brahmavṛkṣasya bhāmini ..
noccaretpraṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ puroḍāśaṃ na bhakṣayet .. 69 ..
16.28.d:
मध्यपत्रे न भुञ्जीत ब्रह्मवृक्षस्य भामिनि ..
नोच्चरेत्प्रणवं मंत्रं पुरोडाशं न भक्षयेत् .. 69 ..
16.28.m: O lovely woman, he must not eat from the central leaf of the Brahmā tree [palāśa]; / he must not utter the praṇava mantra, nor partake of the sacrificial cake.

16.28.s:
na śikhāṃ nopavītaṃ ca nocca retsaṃskṛtāṃ giram ..
na paṭhedvedavacanaṃ trairātraṃ na hi sevayet .. 7.1.28.70 ..
16.28.d:
न शिखां नोपवीतं च नोच्च रेत्संस्कृतां गिरम् ..
न पठेद्वेदवचनं त्रैरात्रं न हि सेवयेत् .. 7.1.28.70 ..
16.28.m: He should have neither a tuft of hair nor a sacred thread, nor speak Sanskrit speech; / he must not recite the word of the Veda, and he must not practice a three-night fast.

16.28.s:
namaskāreṇa śūdrasya kriyāsiddhirbhaveddhruvam ..
niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ kurvanpitṛbhiḥ saha majjati .. 71 ..
16.28.d:
नमस्कारेण शूद्रस्य क्रियासिद्धिर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
निषिद्धाचरणं कुर्वन्पितृभिः सह मज्जति .. 71 ..
16.28.m: Success in rites for a śūdra surely comes through mere salutation. / One who practices what is forbidden sinks down along with his ancestors.

16.28.s:
yenaikādaśasaṃkhyāni yaṃtritānīṃdriyāṇi vai ..
sa tīrthaphalamāpnoti naro'nyaḥ kleśabhāgbhavet .. 72 ..
16.28.d:
येनैकादशसंख्यानि यंत्रितानींद्रियाणि वै ..
स तीर्थफलमाप्नोति नरोऽन्यः क्लेशभाग्भवेत् .. 72 ..
16.28.m: A man by whom the eleven sense-organs are truly restrained / obtains the fruit of the sacred ford; any other man merely partakes of distress.

16.28.s:
yacca tīrthe pitṛśrāddhaṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
hitakārī ca bhūtebhyaḥ so'śnīyāttīrthajaṃ phalam .. 73 ..
16.28.d:
यच्च तीर्थे पितृश्राद्धं स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
हितकारी च भूतेभ्यः सोऽश्नीयात्तीर्थजं फलम् .. 73 ..
16.28.m: One who performs śrāddha to the ancestors and takes a ritual ablution at the sacred ford, / and works for the benefit of living beings, he will enjoy the fruit born of the sacred ford.

16.28.s:
dharmadhvajī sadā lubdhaḥ paradārarato hi yaḥ ..
karoti tīrthagamanaṃ sa naraḥ pātakī bhavet.. 74 ..
16.28.d:
धर्मध्वजी सदा लुब्धः परदाररतो हि यः ..
करोति तीर्थगमनं स नरः पातकी भवेत्.. 74 ..
16.28.m: A hypocrite, one who is ever greedy, or one devoted to another’s wife / who makes a pilgrimage to a sacred ford—that man becomes a sinner.

16.28.s:
evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi yātrāṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
tīrthopavāsaṃ kṛtvādau śraddhāyukto dṛḍhavrataḥ .. 75 ..
16.28.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा महादेवि यात्रां कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
तीर्थोपवासं कृत्वादौ श्रद्धायुक्तो दृढव्रतः .. 75 ..
16.28.m: Knowing this, O great goddess, one should undertake the pilgrimage according to the rules, / having first fasted at the sacred ford, endowed with faith and firm in vow.

16.28.s:
bhojanaṃ naiva kurvīta yadī ccheddhitamātmanaḥ ..
parānnaṃ naiva bhuñjīta taddine brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit ..76..
16.28.d:
भोजनं नैव कुर्वीत यदी च्छेद्धितमात्मनः ..
परान्नं नैव भुञ्जीत तद्दिने ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् ..76..
16.28.m: If one desires one’s own welfare, one should not eat; / a brahmin must never eat food from another on that day.

16.28.s:
hastyaśvarathayānāni bhūmigokāṃcanādikam ..
sarvaṃ tatparigṛhṇīyādbhojanaṃ na samācaret .. 77 ..
16.28.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथयानानि भूमिगोकांचनादिकम् ..
सर्वं तत्परिगृह्णीयाद्भोजनं न समाचरेत् .. 77 ..
16.28.m: Vehicles such as elephants, horses, and chariots, land, cows, gold, and the like— / he may accept all that, but he must not take a meal.

16.28.s:
āmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuñjato dadato'pi vā ..
tīrthopavāsaṃ kurvīta tasmāttatra varānane .. 78 ..
16.28.d:
आमाच्छतगुणं पुण्यं भुञ्जतो ददतोऽपि वा ..
तीर्थोपवासं कुर्वीत तस्मात्तत्र वरानने .. 78 ..
16.28.m: The merit is a hundredfold from raw food, whether eating it or giving it. / Therefore, O fair-faced woman, one should fast at the sacred ford there.

16.28.s:
vratī ca tīrthayātrī ca vidhavā ca viśeṣataḥ ..
parānnabhojane devi yasyānnaṃ tasya tatphalam .. 79 ..
16.28.d:
व्रती च तीर्थयात्री च विधवा च विशेषतः ..
परान्नभोजने देवि यस्यान्नं तस्य तत्फलम् .. 79 ..
16.28.m: For one who is observing a vow, for a pilgrim to a sacred ford, and especially for a widow, / when eating another's food, O goddess, the fruit belongs to the owner of the food.

16.28.s:
vidhavā caiva yā nārī tasyā yātrāvidhiṃ bruve ..
kuṃkumaṃ candanaṃ caiva tāṃbūlaṃ ca srajastathā .. 7.1.28.80 ..
16.28.d:
विधवा चैव या नारी तस्या यात्राविधिं ब्रुवे ..
कुंकुमं चन्दनं चैव तांबूलं च स्रजस्तथा .. 7.1.28.80 ..
16.28.m: And for a woman who is a widow, I shall declare the rules of pilgrimage: / saffron, sandalwood, betel, and garlands;

16.28.s:
raktavastrāṇi sarvāṇi śayyā prāstaraṇāni ca ..
aśiṣṭaiḥ saha saṃbhāṣo dvivāraṃ bhojanaṃ tathā .. 81 ..
16.28.d:
रक्तवस्त्राणि सर्वाणि शय्या प्रास्तरणानि च ..
अशिष्टैः सह संभाषो द्विवारं भोजनं तथा .. 81 ..
16.28.m: all red garments, beds and mattresses, / conversation with uncultured people, and eating twice [a day];

16.28.s:
puṃsāṃ pradarśanaṃ caiva hāsyaṃ tamasi varjayet ..
saśabdopānahau caiva nṛtyaṃ gatiṃ ca varjayet .. 82 ..
16.28.d:
पुंसां प्रदर्शनं चैव हास्यं तमसि वर्जयेत् ..
सशब्दोपानहौ चैव नृत्यं गतिं च वर्जयेत् .. 82 ..
16.28.m: showing herself to men, laughing in the dark, / noisy shoes, dancing, and [frivolous] movement she must avoid;

16.28.s:
dhāraṇaṃ caiva keśānāmaṃjanaṃ ca vilepanam ..
asatījanasaṃsargaṃ pāṃḍityaṃ ca parityajet .. 83 ..
16.28.d:
धारणं चैव केशानामंजनं च विलेपनम् ..
असतीजनसंसर्गं पांडित्यं च परित्यजेत् .. 83 ..
16.28.m: keeping long hair, applying collyrium and ointments, / associating with unchaste women, and showing off learning she must abandon.

16.28.s:
nityaṃ snānaṃ ca kurvīta śvetavastrāṇi dhārayet ..
yatiśca brahmacārī ca vidhavā ca viśeṣataḥ .. 84 ..
16.28.d:
नित्यं स्नानं च कुर्वीत श्वेतवस्त्राणि धारयेत् ..
यतिश्च ब्रह्मचारी च विधवा च विशेषतः .. 84 ..
16.28.m: She should take a ritual ablution daily and wear white garments. / An ascetic, a student of the Veda, and especially a widow:

16.28.s:
tāṃbūlaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca surāpānasamaṃ viduḥ ..
eteṣāṃ varjjanāddevi samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 95 ..
.. devyuvāca .. ..
tapāṃsi kāni kathyante kṣetre prābhā sike naraiḥ ..
kāni dānāni dīyante keṣu tīrtheṣu vā katham .. 86 ..
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamiṣyate ..
dvāpare yajanaṃ dhanyaṃ dānamekaṃ kalau yuge ..87..
tapastapyanti munayaḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādikam ..
gatvā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ lokāścānye kṛte yuge ..88..
kalau dānāni dīyante brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapasāṃ prāpyate phalam .. 89 ..
tulāpuruṣabrahmāṇḍapṛthivīkalpapādapāḥ ..
hiraṇya kāmadhenuśca gajavājirathāstathā .. 7.1.28.90 ..
ratnadhenuhiraṇyāśvasaptasāgara eva ca ..
mahābhūtaghaṭo viśvacakrakalpalatābhidhaḥ .. 91 ..
16.28.d:
तांबूलं मधु मांसं च सुरापानसमं विदुः ..
एतेषां वर्ज्जनाद्देवि सम्यग्यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 95 ..
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
तपांसि कानि कथ्यन्ते क्षेत्रे प्राभा सिके नरैः ..
कानि दानानि दीयन्ते केषु तीर्थेषु वा कथम् .. 86 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
तपः परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां ज्ञानमिष्यते ..
द्वापरे यजनं धन्यं दानमेकं कलौ युगे ..87..
तपस्तप्यन्ति मुनयः कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिकम् ..
गत्वा प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं लोकाश्चान्ये कृते युगे ..88..
कलौ दानानि दीयन्ते ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाविधि ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपसां प्राप्यते फलम् .. 89 ..
तुलापुरुषब्रह्माण्डपृथिवीकल्पपादपाः ..
हिरण्य कामधेनुश्च गजवाजिरथास्तथा .. 7.1.28.90 ..
रत्नधेनुहिरण्याश्वसप्तसागर एव च ..
महाभूतघटो विश्वचक्रकल्पलताभिधः .. 91 ..
16.28.m:
they consider betel, honey, and meat to be equal to drinking liquor. / By avoiding these, O goddess, one obtains the full fruit of pilgrimage.
The Goddess said: / What austerities are declared by men in the sacred field of Prabhāsa? / What gifts are given, at which sacred fords, and in what manner?
The Lord said: / Austerity was supreme in the Kṛta age; knowledge is desired in the Tretā; / in the Dvāpara, sacrifice was blessed; giving alone is [supreme] in the Kali age.
Sages and other people in the Kṛta age, having gone to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / practiced austerities such as the kṛcchra, cāndrāyaṇa, and others.
In the Kali age, gifts are given to brahmins according to the rules. / Reaching the sacred field of Prabhāsa, the fruit of austerities is obtained.
The Weighing of a Man, the Cosmic Egg, the Earth, the Wish-Granting Trees, / the Golden Cow of Desires, and likewise elephants, horses, and chariots;
the Jewel Cow, the Golden Horse, and the Seven Oceans, / the Pot of Great Elements, and the ones named the Universal Wheel and the Wish-Granting Creeper:

16.28.s:
prabhāse nṛpatirdadyā nmahādānāni ṣoḍaśa ..
dhānyaratnaguḍasvarṇatilakārpāsaśarkarāḥ .. 92 ..
sarpirlavaṇarūpyākhyā daśaite parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
guḍājyadadhimadhvaṃbusalila kṣīraśarkarāḥ ..
ratnākhyāśca svarūpeṇa daśaitā dhenavo matāḥ .. 93 ..
teṣāmekatamaṃ dānaṃ tīrthetīrthe pṛthakpṛthak ..
pradeyānyekavāraṃ vā sarasvatyabdhi saṃgame .. 94 ..
sarvasvaṃ cātividuṣe gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam ..
bahvalpamapi viprebhyo dātavyaṃ priyamelake ..95..
16.28.d:
प्रभासे नृपतिर्दद्या न्महादानानि षोडश ..
धान्यरत्नगुडस्वर्णतिलकार्पासशर्कराः .. 92 ..
सर्पिर्लवणरूप्याख्या दशैते पर्वताः स्मृताः ..
गुडाज्यदधिमध्वंबुसलिल क्षीरशर्कराः ..
रत्नाख्याश्च स्वरूपेण दशैता धेनवो मताः .. 93 ..
तेषामेकतमं दानं तीर्थेतीर्थे पृथक्पृथक् ..
प्रदेयान्येकवारं वा सरस्वत्यब्धि संगमे .. 94 ..
सर्वस्वं चातिविदुषे गृहं वा सपरिच्छदम् ..
बह्वल्पमपि विप्रेभ्यो दातव्यं प्रियमेलके ..95..
16.28.m:
a king should give these sixteen great gifts at Prabhāsa. / Grain, jewels, jaggery, gold, sesame, cotton, sugar,
clarified butter, salt, and silver—these are recorded as the ten mountain [gifts]. / Jaggery, clarified butter, curds, honey-water, fresh water, milk, sugar,
One of these gifts should be given at each sacred ford separately, / or all together at once at the confluence of the Sarasvatī and the ocean.
One's entire property to a very learned man, or a house with furnishings, / much or even little, should be given to brahmins at Priyamelaka.

16.28.s:
yatra tīrthe labhelliṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ ca vimalodakam..
tatrāgnikāryaṃ kṛtvādau viśiṣṭaṃ dānamiṣyate ..96..
16.28.d:
यत्र तीर्थे लभेल्लिंगं तीर्थं च विमलोदकम्..
तत्राग्निकार्यं कृत्वादौ विशिष्टं दानमिष्यते ..96..
16.28.m: At whatever sacred ford one finds a liṅga and a sacred ford with pure water, / having first performed the fire rite there, an excellent gift is commended.

16.28.s:
tarpaṇaṃ pitṛdevānāṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ sadakṣiṇam ..
tīrthetīrthe ca godānaṃ niyataḥ prakṛto vidhiḥ .. .. 97 ..
16.28.d:
तर्पणं पितृदेवानां श्राद्धं दानं सदक्षिणम् ..
तीर्थेतीर्थे च गोदानं नियतः प्रकृतो विधिः .. .. 97 ..
16.28.m: The libation to the ancestors and gods, śrāddha, a gift with a sacrificial fee, / and the gift of a cow at each sacred ford is the fixed, natural rule.

16.28.s:
viśiṣṭakhyātaliṃgeṣu vṛṣadānaṃ vidhīyate ..
snānaṃ vilepanaṃ pūjāṃ devatānāṃ samācaret .. 98 ..
16.28.d:
विशिष्टख्यातलिंगेषु वृषदानं विधीयते ..
स्नानं विलेपनं पूजां देवतानां समाचरेत् .. 98 ..
16.28.m: At renowned, distinguished liṅgas, the gift of a bull is prescribed. / One should perform ritual ablution, anointing, and worship of the deities.

16.28.s:
jagatīṃ cārcayedbhaktyā tathā caivopalepayet ..
prāsādaṃ dhavalaṃ saudhaṃ kārayejjīrṇamuddharet .. 99 ..
16.28.d:
जगतीं चार्चयेद्भक्त्या तथा चैवोपलेपयेत् ..
प्रासादं धवलं सौधं कारयेज्जीर्णमुद्धरेत् .. 99 ..
16.28.m: One should worship the terrace with devotion, and likewise smear it [with cow dung]. / One should whitewash the palace temple and restore what is dilapidated.

16.28.s:
puṣpavāṭīṃ snānakūpaṃ nirmalaṃ kārayedvratī ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ bhūridānaṃ devapūjākarāya ca .. 7.1.28.100 ..
16.28.d:
पुष्पवाटीं स्नानकूपं निर्मलं कारयेद्व्रती ..
ब्राह्मणानां भूरिदानं देवपूजाकराय च .. 7.1.28.100 ..
16.28.m: The vow-observer should make a flower garden and a pure well for bathing, / [and make] lavish gifts to brahmins and to the one who performs the deity's worship.

16.28.s:
sarvatra devayātrāyāṃ vidhireṣa pravarttate ..
tīrthamabhyuddharejjīrṇaṃ mārjayetkathayetphalam .. 101 ..
16.28.d:
सर्वत्र देवयात्रायां विधिरेष प्रवर्त्तते ..
तीर्थमभ्युद्धरेज्जीर्णं मार्जयेत्कथयेत्फलम् .. 101 ..
16.28.m: In every pilgrimage to the gods, this rule applies: / one should restore a ruined sacred ford, clean it, and proclaim its fruit.

16.28.s:
prasiddhe ca mahādānaṃ madhyame caiva madhyamam ..
godānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu suvarṇamatha niṣkrayaḥ ..
hiraṇyadānaṃ sarveṣāṃ dānānāmeva niṣkṛtiḥ .. 102 ..
16.28.d:
प्रसिद्धे च महादानं मध्यमे चैव मध्यमम् ..
गोदानं सर्वतीर्थेषु सुवर्णमथ निष्क्रयः ..
हिरण्यदानं सर्वेषां दानानामेव निष्कृतिः .. 102 ..
16.28.m: At a famous [ford], a great gift; at a middling one, a middling gift; / the gift of a cow at all sacred fords; or gold as a substitute: / the gift of gold is indeed the substitute for all gifts.

16.28.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā labhate janmanaḥ phalam ..
tīrtheṣu dānaṃ vakṣyāmi yeṣu yaddīyate tithau .. 103 ..
16.28.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या लभते जन्मनः फलम् ..
तीर्थेषु दानं वक्ष्यामि येषु यद्दीयते तिथौ .. 103 ..
16.28.m: Having done this with devotion, a man obtains the fruit of his birth. / I shall describe the gifts at the sacred fords, and which [gift] is given on which lunar day.

16.28.s:
prabhāse pratipaddānaṃ dātavyaṃ kāṃcanaṃ śubham ..
dvitīyāyāṃ tathā vastraṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ ca medinīm .. ..104 ..
16.28.d:
प्रभासे प्रतिपद्दानं दातव्यं कांचनं शुभम् ..
द्वितीयायां तथा वस्त्रं तृतीयायां च मेदिनीम् .. ..104 ..
16.28.m: At Prabhāsa, on the first lunar day, an auspicious gift of gold should be given; / on the second, cloth; and on the third, land.

16.28.s:
caturthyāṃ dāpayeddhānyaṃ paṃcamyāṃ kapilāṃ tathā ..
ṣaṣṭhyāmaśvaṃ ca saptamyāṃ mahiṣīṃ tatra dāpayet .. 105..
16.28.d:
चतुर्थ्यां दापयेद्धान्यं पंचम्यां कपिलां तथा ..
षष्ठ्यामश्वं च सप्तम्यां महिषीं तत्र दापयेत् .. 105..
16.28.m: On the fourth lunar day, one should give grain, and on the fifth, a tawny cow; / on the sixth, a horse, and on the seventh, one should give a female buffalo there.

16.28.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā nīlaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutam ..
navamyāṃ tu gṛhaṃ dadyāccakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ tathā .. 106 ..
16.28.d:
अष्टम्यां वृषभं दत्त्वा नीलं लक्षणसंयुतम् ..
नवम्यां तु गृहं दद्याच्चक्रं शंखं गदां तथा .. 106 ..
16.28.m: On the eighth, having given a dark bull endowed with auspicious marks, / on the ninth, one should give a house, as well as a discus, a conch, and a mace.

16.28.s:
daśamyāṃ sarvagaṃdhāṃśca ekādaśyāṃ ca mauktikam ..
dvādaśyāṃ suvratennādyaṃ pravālaṃ vidhivattathā .. 107 ..
16.28.d:
दशम्यां सर्वगंधांश्च एकादश्यां च मौक्तिकम् ..
द्वादश्यां सुव्रतेन्नाद्यं प्रवालं विधिवत्तथा .. 107 ..
16.28.m: On the tenth, all kinds of perfumes, and on the eleventh, a pearl; / on the twelfth, O lady of good vows, food, and coral according to rule.

16.28.s:
striyo deyāstrayodaśyāṃ bhūtāyāṃ jñānado bhavet..
amāvāsyāmanuprāpya sarvadānāni dāpayet .. 108 ..
16.28.d:
स्त्रियो देयास्त्रयोदश्यां भूतायां ज्ञानदो भवेत्..
अमावास्यामनुप्राप्य सर्वदानानि दापयेत् .. 108 ..
16.28.m: On the thirteenth, women should be given; on the fourteenth, one should bestow knowledge; / on reaching the new-moon day, one should give all gifts.

16.28.s: evaṃ dānaṃ pradattvā tu daśa kṛtvaḥ phalaṃ labhet .. 109 ..
16.28.d: एवं दानं प्रदत्त्वा तु दश कृत्वः फलं लभेत् .. 109 ..
16.28.m: Having thus given a gift, one obtains ten times the fruit.

.. devyuvāca .. ..

snānamantravihīnāśca vada teṣāṃ tu kiṃ phalam .. .. 7.1.28.110 ..

.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भक्तिदानविहीना ये प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः ..
स्नानमन्त्रविहीनाश्च वद तेषां तु किं फलम् .. .. 7.1.28.110 ..
16.28.m: The goddess said: / Those who come to the sacred field of Prabhāsa devoid of devotion and gifts, / and devoid of ritual ablution and mantras—tell [me], what is their fruit?

16.28.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sadhanā nirddhanā vāpi samaṃtrā maṃtravarjitāḥ ..
prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ sarve yāṃti śivālayam .. 111 ..
16.28.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सधना निर्द्धना वापि समंत्रा मंत्रवर्जिताः ..
प्रभासे निधनं प्राप्ताः सर्वे यांति शिवालयम् .. 111 ..
16.28.m: Īśvara said: / Whether rich or poor, with mantras or without mantras, / all who meet death in Prabhāsa go to the abode of Śiva.

16.28.s:
ye maṃtrahīnāḥ puruṣā dharmahīnāśca ye mṛtāḥ ..
teṣāmekaṃ vimānaṃ tu dadāmi sumahatpriye .. 112 ..
16.28.d:
ये मंत्रहीनाः पुरुषा धर्महीनाश्च ये मृताः ..
तेषामेकं विमानं तु ददामि सुमहत्प्रिये .. 112 ..
16.28.m: Those men who die devoid of mantras and devoid of dharma, / to them, O beloved, I give one very great aerial chariot.

16.28.s:
snānadānānurūpyeṇa prāpnuvaṃti paraṃ padam ..
kecitsnānaprabhāvena keciddānena mānavāḥ .. 113 ..
16.28.d:
स्नानदानानुरूप्येण प्राप्नुवंति परं पदम् ..
केचित्स्नानप्रभावेन केचिद्दानेन मानवाः .. 113 ..
16.28.m: According to their ritual ablution and gifts, men attain the supreme state: / some through the power of ritual ablution, some through gifts;

16.28.s:
kecilliṃgapraṇāmena kecilliṃgārccanena ca ..
keciddhyānaprabhāvena kecidyogaprabhāvataḥ .. 114 ..
16.28.d:
केचिल्लिंगप्रणामेन केचिल्लिंगार्च्चनेन च ..
केचिद्ध्यानप्रभावेन केचिद्योगप्रभावतः .. 114 ..
16.28.m: some through prostration to the liṅga, some through worship of the liṅga; / some through the power of meditation, some through the power of yoga;

16.28.s:
kecinmaṃ trasya jāpyena kecicca tapasā śubhe ..
tīrthe saṃnyasanaiḥ kecitkecidbhaktyanusārataḥ ..115 ..
16.28.d:
केचिन्मं त्रस्य जाप्येन केचिच्च तपसा शुभे ..
तीर्थे संन्यसनैः केचित्केचिद्भक्त्यनुसारतः ..115 ..
16.28.m: some through the chanting of mantras, and some through austerity, O auspicious lady; / some through renunciation at the sacred ford, and some according to their devotion.

16.28.s:
ete cānye ca bahava uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ ..
sarve śivapuraṃ yāṃti vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ .. 116 ..
16.28.d:
एते चान्ये च बहव उत्तमाधममध्यमाः ..
सर्वे शिवपुरं यांति विमानैः सूर्यसंनिभैः .. 116 ..
16.28.m: These and many others—the highest, the lowest, and the middling— / all go to the city of Śiva in aerial chariots resembling the sun.

16.28.s:
triśūlāṃkitahastāśca sarve ca vṛṣavāhanāḥ ..
divyāpsarogaṇākīrṇāḥ krīḍaṃte matprabhāvataḥ .. 117 ..
16.28.d:
त्रिशूलांकितहस्ताश्च सर्वे च वृषवाहनाः ..
दिव्याप्सरोगणाकीर्णाः क्रीडंते मत्प्रभावतः .. 117 ..
16.28.m: With hands marked by tridents, and all riding bulls, / surrounded by hosts of divine apsarases, they disport themselves through my power.

16.28.s:
evaṃ bhaktyanusāreṇa dadāmi phalamavyayam..
alepakaṃ prabhāsaṃ tu dharmādharmairna lipyate .. 118 ..
16.28.d:
एवं भक्त्यनुसारेण ददामि फलमव्ययम्..
अलेपकं प्रभासं तु धर्माधर्मैर्न लिप्यते .. 118 ..
16.28.m: Thus, according to their devotion, I give imperishable fruit. / Prabhāsa is unblemished; it is not tainted by dharma or adharma.

16.28.s: dharmaṃ caraṃtyadharmaṃ vā śivaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 119 ..
16.28.d: धर्मं चरंत्यधर्मं वा शिवं यांति न संशयः .. 119 ..
16.28.m: Whether they practice dharma or adharma, they go to Śiva, without a doubt.

16.28.s:
janmaprabhṛti yo devi naro netravivarjitaḥ ..
mama kṣetre mṛtaḥ so'pi rudraloke mahīyate .. 7.1.28.120 ..
16.28.d:
जन्मप्रभृति यो देवि नरो नेत्रविवर्जितः ..
मम क्षेत्रे मृतः सोऽपि रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 7.1.28.120 ..
16.28.m: O goddess, even a man who has been blind since birth, / if he dies in my sacred field, is honored in the world of Rudra.

16.28.s:
janmaprabhṛti yo devi śravaṇābhyāṃ vivarjitaḥ ..
prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ sa bhavenmatparigrahaḥ .. 121 ..
16.28.d:
जन्मप्रभृति यो देवि श्रवणाभ्यां विवर्जितः ..
प्रभासे निधनं प्राप्तः स भवेन्मत्परिग्रहः .. 121 ..
16.28.m: O goddess, he who has been deaf since birth, / if he meets death in Prabhāsa, becomes my own.

16.28.s:
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ sparśane vidhim ..
mantreṇa maṃtritaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavetsaṃnihitaṃ tathā .. ...122 ..
16.28.d:
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि तीर्थानां स्पर्शने विधिम् ..
मन्त्रेण मंत्रितं तीर्थं भवेत्संनिहितं तथा .. ...122 ..
16.28.m: Now, therefore, I shall declare the rule for touching the sacred fords: / consecrated with a mantra, the sacred ford becomes present.

16.28.s:
prathamaṃ cālabhettīrthaṃ praṇavena jalaṃ śuci ..
avagāhya tataḥ snāyādadhyātmamantrayogataḥ .. 123 ..
16.28.d:
प्रथमं चालभेत्तीर्थं प्रणवेन जलं शुचि ..
अवगाह्य ततः स्नायादध्यात्ममन्त्रयोगतः .. 123 ..
16.28.m: First, one should touch the pure water of the sacred ford with the syllable Oṃ; / then, plunging in, one should bathe in conjunction with the spiritual mantra:

16.28.s:
oṃnamo devadevāya śitikaṇṭhāya daṃḍine ..
rudrāya vāmahastāya cakriṇe vedhase namaḥ .. 124 ..
16.28.d:
ओंनमो देवदेवाय शितिकण्ठाय दंडिने ..
रुद्राय वामहस्ताय चक्रिणे वेधसे नमः .. 124 ..
16.28.m: “Oṃ, salutation to the God of gods, the dark-throated one, the staff-bearer, / to Rudra, whose hand is auspicious, the discus-wielder, the creator, salutation!

16.28.s:
sarasvatī ca sāvitrī vedamātā vibhāvarī ..
saṃnidhānaṃ kuruṣvātra tīrthe pāpa praṇāśini ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ maṃtra eṣa udāhṛtaḥ .. 125 ..
16.28.d:
सरस्वती च सावित्री वेदमाता विभावरी ..
संनिधानं कुरुष्वात्र तीर्थे पाप प्रणाशिनि ..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां मंत्र एष उदाहृतः .. 125 ..
16.28.m: Sarasvatī and Sāvitrī, Mother of the Vedas, Night: / make your presence here in this sacred ford, O destroyer of sins!” / This mantra is declared for all the sacred fords.

16.28.s:
ityuccārya namaskṛtvā snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttasminnahani suvrate .. 126 ..
16.28.d:
इत्युच्चार्य नमस्कृत्वा स्नानं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
उपवासं ततः कुर्यात्तस्मिन्नहनि सुव्रते .. 126 ..
16.28.m: Having uttered this and bowed, one should perform the ritual ablution according to rule; / then, O lady of good vows, one should observe a fast on that day.

16.28.s: sā tithirvarṣamekaṃ tu upoṣyā bhaktitatparaiḥ .. 127 ..
16.28.d: सा तिथिर्वर्षमेकं तु उपोष्या भक्तितत्परैः .. 127 ..
16.28.m: That lunar day should be fasted on for one year by those intent on devotion.

16.28.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kasmiṃstīrthe naraiḥ pūrvaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgataiḥ ..
snānaṃ kāryaṃ mahādevi tanme vistarato vada .. 128 ..
16.28.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरैः पूर्वं प्रभासक्षेत्रमागतैः ..
स्नानं कार्यं महादेवि तन्मे विस्तरतो वद .. 128 ..
16.28.m: The goddess said: / At which sacred ford should ritual ablution first be performed by men who have arrived at the sacred field of Prabhāsa? / O great god, tell me that in detail.

16.28.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi ādyaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham ..
pūrvaṃ yatra naraiḥ snānaṃ kriyate tacchṛṣuṣva me .. 129 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tīrthayātrā vidhānavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 28 ..
16.28.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
हंत ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि आद्यं तीर्थं महाप्रभम् ..
पूर्वं यत्र नरैः स्नानं क्रियते तच्छृषुष्व मे .. 129 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तीर्थयात्रा विधानवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः .. 28 ..
16.28.m:
Īśvara said: / Well, I shall tell you of the first sacred ford of great splendor, / where ritual ablution is performed first by men; hear that from me.
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Rules for Pilgrimage to Sacred Fords', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.29.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
agnitīrthaṃ tato gacchetsāgarasya taṭe śubhe ..
yatrā'sau vāḍavo muktaḥ sarasvatyā varānane .. 1 ..
16.29.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अग्नितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सागरस्य तटे शुभे ..
यत्राऽसौ वाडवो मुक्तः सरस्वत्या वरानने .. 1 ..
16.29.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go to Agnitīrtha on the auspicious shore of the ocean, / where that submarine fire was released by Sarasvatī, O fair-faced lady.

16.29.s:
dakṣiṇe somanāthasya sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ padmakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 2 ..
16.29.d:
दक्षिणे सोमनाथस्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं पद्मकं नाम नामतः .. 2 ..
16.29.m: To the south of Somanātha is the sacred ford known in the three worlds, / named Padmaka by name, which destroys all sins.

16.29.s:
dhanvaṃtaraśate proktaṃ someśājjalamadhyagam..
kuṇḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ proktaṃ śatahastapramāṇataḥ ..
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vigāhya nidhimaṃbhasām .. 3 ..
16.29.d:
धन्वंतरशते प्रोक्तं सोमेशाज्जलमध्यगम्..
कुण्डं पापहरं प्रोक्तं शतहस्तप्रमाणतः ..
तत्र स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत विगाह्य निधिमंभसाम् .. 3 ..
16.29.m: At a distance of a hundred bows from Someśa, situated within the water, / is the pool destroying sin, declared to be a hundred cubits in measure; / having plunged into the storehouse of waters, one should perform ritual ablution there,

16.29.s:
ādau kṛtvā tu vapanaṃ someśvarasamīpataḥ ..
śaṃkaraṃ manasā dhyāyankeśāṃstatra parityajet ..
samuttārya tataḥ keśānbhūyaḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 4 ..
16.29.d:
आदौ कृत्वा तु वपनं सोमेश्वरसमीपतः ..
शंकरं मनसा ध्यायन्केशांस्तत्र परित्यजेत् ..
समुत्तार्य ततः केशान्भूयः स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 4 ..
16.29.m: having first performed shaving near Someśvara; / meditating on Śaṃkara in one’s mind, one should cast off one's hair there; / having removed the hair, one should then perform ritual ablution again.

16.29.s:
yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ manuṣyo vṛttikarśitaḥ ..
tadeva parvatasute sarvaṃ keśeṣu tiṣṭhati .. 5 ..
16.29.d:
यत्किंचित्कुरुते पापं मनुष्यो वृत्तिकर्शितः ..
तदेव पर्वतसुते सर्वं केशेषु तिष्ठति .. 5 ..
16.29.m: Whatever sin a man commits, afflicted by livelihood, / that entirely stays in the hair, O daughter of the mountain.

16.29.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena keśāṃstatra vinikṣipet ..
tadeva somanāthāgre kṛtvā tu dviguṇaṃ phalam.. 6 ..
16.29.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन केशांस्तत्र विनिक्षिपेत् ..
तदेव सोमनाथाग्रे कृत्वा तु द्विगुणं फलम्.. 6 ..
16.29.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should cast off hair there; / doing that in front of Somanātha, the fruit is doubled.

16.29.s:
agnitīrthasamīpasthaṃ kaparddidvāramadhyagam ..
tatraiva dviguṇaṃ jñeyamanyatraikaguṇaṃ smṛtam .. 7 ..
16.29.d:
अग्नितीर्थसमीपस्थं कपर्द्दिद्वारमध्यगम् ..
तत्रैव द्विगुणं ज्ञेयमन्यत्रैकगुणं स्मृतम् .. 7 ..
16.29.m: Near Agnitīrtha, located within Kapardidvāra— / right there it is known to be twofold, while elsewhere it is remembered as single.

16.29.s:
kṣurakarma na śastaṃ syādyoṣitāṃ tu varānane ..
sabhartṛkāṇāṃ tatraiva vidhiṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇuṣva me .. 8 ..
16.29.d:
क्षुरकर्म न शस्तं स्याद्योषितां तु वरानने ..
सभर्तृकाणां तत्रैव विधिं तासां शृणुष्व मे .. 8 ..
16.29.m: Tonsure is not commended for women, O fair-faced lady, / whose husbands are alive; hear from me the rule for them right there:

16.29.s:
sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya cchedayedaṃguladvayam ..
tato devānvidhānena tarppayetpitṛdevatāḥ..9..
16.29.d:
सर्वान्केशान्समुद्धृत्य च्छेदयेदंगुलद्वयम् ..
ततो देवान्विधानेन तर्प्पयेत्पितृदेवताः..9..
16.29.m: Gathering all the hair, one should cut off two finger-breadths; / then, according to rule, one should make libations to the gods and the ancestral deities.

16.29.s: muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ .. 7.1.29.10 ..
16.29.d: मुण्डनं चोपवासश्च सर्वतीर्थेष्वयं विधिः .. 7.1.29.10 ..
16.29.m: Shaving and fasting—this is the rule at all sacred fords.

16.29.s:
gaṃgāyāṃ bhāskare kṣetre mātāpitrorgurau mṛte ..
ādhāne somapāne ca vapanaṃ saptasu smṛtam .. 11 ..
16.29.d:
गंगायां भास्करे क्षेत्रे मातापित्रोर्गुरौ मृते ..
आधाने सोमपाने च वपनं सप्तसु स्मृतम् .. 11 ..
16.29.m: At the Gaṅgā, at Bhāskarakṣetra, upon the death of mother, father, or guru, / at the laying of sacred fires, and at the drinking of soma—shaving is remembered in these seven.

16.29.s:
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ yaḥ samācaret ..
nāsau tatphalamāpnoti vapanādyacca labhyate .. 12 ..
16.29.d:
अश्वमेधसहस्राणां सहस्रं यः समाचरेत् ..
नासौ तत्फलमाप्नोति वपनाद्यच्च लभ्यते .. 12 ..
16.29.m: He who performs a thousand thousands of horse sacrifices / does not obtain the fruit that is gained through shaving.

16.29.s:
vinā mantreṇa yastatra devi snānaṃ samācaret ..
samāpnoti kvacicchreyo muktvaikaṃ parvavāsaram.. 13 ..
16.29.d:
विना मन्त्रेण यस्तत्र देवि स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
समाप्नोति क्वचिच्छ्रेयो मुक्त्वैकं पर्ववासरम्.. 13 ..
16.29.m: He who performs ritual ablution there without a mantra, O goddess, / rarely obtains welfare, except on a single day of conjunction.

16.29.s:
vinā maṃtraṃ vinā parva kṣurakarma vinā naraiḥ ..
kuśāgreṇāpi deveśi na spraṣṭavyo mahodadhiḥ .. .. 14 ..
16.29.d:
विना मंत्रं विना पर्व क्षुरकर्म विना नरैः ..
कुशाग्रेणापि देवेशि न स्प्रष्टव्यो महोदधिः .. .. 14 ..
16.29.m: Without a mantra, without a day of conjunction, without the act of shaving, / the great ocean must not be touched by men even with the tip of a kuśa blade, O ruler of gods.

16.29.s:
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena dattvā'rghyaṃ ca mahodadhau ..
saṃpūjya puṣpagaṃdhaiśca vastraiḥ puṇyānulepanaiḥ .. 15 ..
16.29.d:
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन दत्त्वाऽर्घ्यं च महोदधौ ..
संपूज्य पुष्पगंधैश्च वस्त्रैः पुण्यानुलेपनैः .. 15 ..
16.29.m: Having thus bathed according to rule, and having offered water to the great ocean, / having worshipped it with flowers, perfumes, garments, and auspicious ointments,

16.29.s: hiraṇmayaṃ yathāśaktyā nikṣipettatra kaṃkaṇam .. 16 ..
16.29.d: हिरण्मयं यथाशक्त्या निक्षिपेत्तत्र कंकणम् .. 16 ..
16.29.m: one should throw into it a golden bracelet according to one’s means.

16.29.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu sparśayellavaṇodadhim ..
mantreṇānena deveśi tataḥ sāṃnidhyatāṃ vrajet .. 17 ..
16.29.d:
एवं कृत्वा विधानं तु स्पर्शयेल्लवणोदधिम् ..
मन्त्रेणानेन देवेशि ततः सांनिध्यतां व्रजेत् .. 17 ..
16.29.m: Having thus performed the rite, one should touch the salt ocean / with this mantra, O ruler of gods; then one attains presence.

16.29.s:
oṃ namo viṣṇuguptāya viṣṇurūpāya te namaḥ ..
sāṃnidhye bhava deveśa sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi .. 18 ..
16.29.d:
ओं नमो विष्णुगुप्ताय विष्णुरूपाय ते नमः ..
सांनिध्ये भव देवेश सागरे लवणाम्भसि .. 18 ..
16.29.m: "Oṃ, homage to Viṣṇu-gupta, homage to you whose form is Viṣṇu! / O Lord of Gods, be present in the ocean, in the salt water!"

16.29.s:
agniśca reto mṛḍayā ca deho retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ ..
etadbruvanpārvati satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāhettu patiṃ nadīnām .. 19 ..
16.29.d:
अग्निश्च रेतो मृडया च देहो रेतोधा विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः ..
एतद्ब्रुवन्पार्वति सत्यवाक्यं ततोऽवगाहेत्तु पतिं नदीनाम् .. 19 ..
16.29.m: "Agni is the semen, and by the Gracious One [Śiva] is the body; Viṣṇu holds the semen, the navel of nectar." / Speaking this true utterance, O Pārvatī, one should then plunge into the lord of rivers [the ocean].

16.29.s:
oṃ namo ratnagarbhāya mantreṇānena bhāmini ..
kaṃkaṇaṃ prakṣipettatra tataḥ snāyādyadṛcchayā ..7.1.29.20..
16.29.d:
ओं नमो रत्नगर्भाय मन्त्रेणानेन भामिनि ..
कंकणं प्रक्षिपेत्तत्र ततः स्नायाद्यदृच्छया ..7.1.29.20..
16.29.m: "Oṃ, homage to Ratnagarbha (the jewel-wombed)!" With this mantra, O lovely woman, / one should cast the bracelet there, and then bathe at will.

16.29.s:
tataśca tarpayeddevānmanuṣyāṃśca pitāmahān..
tilamiśreṇa toyena samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ..21..
16.29.d:
ततश्च तर्पयेद्देवान्मनुष्यांश्च पितामहान्..
तिलमिश्रेण तोयेन सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः..21..
16.29.m: And then one should offer libations to the gods, the men, and the ancestors / with water mixed with sesame seeds, fully endowed with faith.

16.29.s:
ājanmaśatasāhasraṃ yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ..
sakṛtsnātvā vyapoheta sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi..22..
16.29.d:
आजन्मशतसाहस्रं यत्पापं कुरुते नरः..
सकृत्स्नात्वा व्यपोहेत सागरे लवणाम्भसि..22..
16.29.m: Whatever sin a man commits across a hundred thousand births, / having bathed just once in the ocean of salt water, he dispels it.

16.29.s:
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ pravṛtte kṣurakarmaṇi..
ātmaprakṛtidānaṃ ca pītavastraṃ tathaiva ca..23..
16.29.d:
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यः प्रवृत्ते क्षुरकर्मणि..
आत्मप्रकृतिदानं च पीतवस्त्रं तथैव च..23..
16.29.m: A bull should be given there when the shaving ritual begins, / and a gift of one's own constitution, as well as yellow cloth.

16.29.s:
anena vidhinā tatra samyaksnānaṃ samācaret ..
sparśayedvāḍavaṃ tejaścānyathā doṣabhāgbhavet .. 24 ..
16.29.d:
अनेन विधिना तत्र सम्यक्स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
स्पर्शयेद्वाडवं तेजश्चान्यथा दोषभाग्भवेत् .. 24 ..
16.29.m: According to this procedure, one should perform the ritual ablution properly there. / One should touch the submarine fire (vāḍava tejas); otherwise, one would incur fault.

16.29.s: varaḥ śāpaśca tasyāyaṃ purā datto yathā dvijaiḥ ... 25 ..
16.29.d: वरः शापश्च तस्यायं पुरा दत्तो यथा द्विजैः ... 25 ..
16.29.m: For this boon and curse were formerly given to it by the brahmins.

16.29.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kutra kutra mahādeva jalasnānādviśudhyati ..
kimarthaṃ sāgare doṣaḥ prāpyate kautukaṃ mahat .. 26 ..
16.29.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कुत्र कुत्र महादेव जलस्नानाद्विशुध्यति ..
किमर्थं सागरे दोषः प्राप्यते कौतुकं महत् .. 26 ..
16.29.m: The Goddess said: / "Everywhere, O Mahādeva, one is purified by bathing in water. / For what reason is fault incurred in the ocean? This is a great wonder!

16.29.s:
yatra gaṃgādayaḥ sarvā nadyo viśrāṃtimāgatāḥ ..
yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ śete yatra lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ sthitā .. 27 ..
16.29.d:
यत्र गंगादयः सर्वा नद्यो विश्रांतिमागताः ..
यत्र विष्णुः स्वयं शेते यत्र लक्ष्मीः स्वयं स्थिता .. 27 ..
16.29.m: Where all rivers such as the Gaṅgā have found their resting place, / where Viṣṇu himself lies, where Lakṣmī herself resides—

16.29.s:
kimarthaṃ varaśāpaṃ tu tasya dattaṃ dvijaiḥ purā ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi mahānme saṃśayo'tra vai .. 28 ..
16.29.d:
किमर्थं वरशापं तु तस्य दत्तं द्विजैः पुरा ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि महान्मे संशयोऽत्र वै .. 28 ..
16.29.m: why was a boon and a curse given to it formerly by the brahmins? / Tell me everything in detail; indeed, great is my doubt in this matter."

16.29.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dīrghasatraṃ purā devi prārabdhaṃ surasattamaiḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ tīrthamāsādya samyakchraddhā samanvitaiḥ .. 29 ..
16.29.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
दीर्घसत्रं पुरा देवि प्रारब्धं सुरसत्तमैः ..
प्रभासं तीर्थमासाद्य सम्यक्छ्रद्धा समन्वितैः .. 29 ..
16.29.m: Īśvara said: / "Formerly, O goddess, a long sacrificial session was begun by the foremost of the gods, / who had arrived at the Prabhāsa tīrtha, fully endowed with faith.

16.29.s:
tataḥ satrāvasāne tu dattvā dānamanekadhā ..
sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām .. 7.1.29.30 ..
16.29.d:
ततः सत्रावसाने तु दत्त्वा दानमनेकधा ..
सर्वस्वं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणां प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनाम् .. 7.1.29.30 ..
16.29.m: Then, at the conclusion of the sacrificial session, having bestowed varied gifts / and their entire property upon the foremost brahmins residing in the Prabhāsa sacred field,

16.29.s:
tāvadanye dvijāstatra dakṣiṇārthaṃ samāgatāḥ ..
deśīyāstatra vāstavyāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 31 ..
16.29.d:
तावदन्ये द्विजास्तत्र दक्षिणार्थं समागताः ..
देशीयास्तत्र वास्तव्याः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 31 ..
16.29.m: meanwhile other brahmins arrived there for the sake of sacrificial fees— / local inhabitants there, by the hundreds and thousands.

16.29.s:
prārthanābhaṅgabhītāśca tato devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
praṇaṣṭāstānsurāndṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāścānuvavrajuḥ .. 32 ..
16.29.d:
प्रार्थनाभङ्गभीताश्च ततो देवाः सवासवाः ..
प्रणष्टास्तान्सुरान्दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणाश्चानुवव्रजुः .. 32 ..
16.29.m: And terrified of disappointing their supplication, the gods along with Indra then / vanished. Seeing those gods [flee], the brahmins pursued them.

16.29.s:
khecaratvaṃ purā devi hyāsīdagrabhuvāṃ mahat ..
tena yāṃti drutaṃ sarve yatra yatra surālayāḥ .. 33 ..
16.29.d:
खेचरत्वं पुरा देवि ह्यासीदग्रभुवां महत् ..
तेन यांति द्रुतं सर्वे यत्र यत्र सुरालयाः .. 33 ..
16.29.m: Formerly, O goddess, the firstborn [brahmins] possessed the great power of flying through the air; / by that means, they all went swiftly wherever the gods' abodes were.

16.29.s:
evaṃ sarvatragāmitvaṃ teṣāṃ vīkṣya divaukasaḥ ..
praviṣṭāḥ sāgaraṃ bhītā ūcurvākyaṃ ca taṃ punaḥ .. 34 ..
16.29.d:
एवं सर्वत्रगामित्वं तेषां वीक्ष्य दिवौकसः ..
प्रविष्टाः सागरं भीता ऊचुर्वाक्यं च तं पुनः .. 34 ..
16.29.m: Seeing their ability to go everywhere in this manner, the dwellers of heaven, / frightened, entered the ocean and spoke these words to it:

16.29.s:
śaraṇaṃ te vayaṃ prāptā brāhmaṇebhyo bhayaṃ gatāḥ ..
nāsti vittaṃ ca dānārthaṃ tasmādrakṣa mahodadhe .. 35 ..
16.29.d:
शरणं ते वयं प्राप्ता ब्राह्मणेभ्यो भयं गताः ..
नास्ति वित्तं च दानार्थं तस्माद्रक्ष महोदधे .. 35 ..
16.29.m: 'We have sought your refuge, seized with fear of the brahmins. / There is no wealth left for giving; therefore, protect us, O great ocean!

16.29.s:
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ ..
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam..
viśeṣataśca devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bahupuṇyadam.. 36 ..
16.29.d:
एकतः क्रतवः सर्वे समाप्तवरदक्षिणाः ..
एकतो भयभीतस्य प्राणिनः प्राणरक्षणम्..
विशेषतश्च देवानां रक्षणं बहुपुण्यदम्.. 36 ..
16.29.m: On one side are all the sacrifices with the boons and sacrificial fees complete; / on the other side is the saving of the life of a creature terrified with fear. / In particular, the protection of the gods bestows great merit.'

16.29.s:
.. samudra uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇebhyo na bhīḥ kāryā kathaṃcitsurasattamāḥ ..
ahaṃ vo rakṣayiṣyāmi praviśadhvaṃ mamodare .. 37 ..
16.29.d:
.. समुद्र उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न भीः कार्या कथंचित्सुरसत्तमाः ..
अहं वो रक्षयिष्यामि प्रविशध्वं ममोदरे .. 37 ..
16.29.m: The Ocean said: / 'No fear of the brahmins should be had in any way, O foremost of the gods! / I will protect you; enter inside my belly.'

16.29.s:
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve tasya vākyena harṣitāḥ ..
praviṣṭā gahvarāṃ kukṣiṃ tasyaiva bhaya varjjitāḥ .. 38 ..
16.29.d:
ततस्ते विबुधाः सर्वे तस्य वाक्येन हर्षिताः ..
प्रविष्टा गह्वरां कुक्षिं तस्यैव भय वर्ज्जिताः .. 38 ..
16.29.m: Then all those deities, delighted by its word, / free from fear, entered the deep belly of that very [ocean].

16.29.s:
samudro'pi mahatkṛtvā nijarūpaṃ ca bhūriśaḥ ..
jalajāñjīvasaṃghātāndhṛtvā tīrasamīpataḥ .. 39 ..
16.29.d:
समुद्रोऽपि महत्कृत्वा निजरूपं च भूरिशः ..
जलजाञ्जीवसंघातान्धृत्वा तीरसमीपतः .. 39 ..
16.29.m: The ocean, too, having expanded its own form greatly, / gathered hosts of living water-creatures near the shore.

16.29.s:
tataścakra upāyaṃ sa brāhmaṇānāṃ nipātane ..
matsyānāmāmiṣaṃ paktvā mahānnena ca gopitam .. 7.1.29.40 ..
16.29.d:
ततश्चक्र उपायं स ब्राह्मणानां निपातने ..
मत्स्यानामामिषं पक्त्वा महान्नेन च गोपितम् .. 7.1.29.40 ..
16.29.m: Then it devised a stratagem for the ruin of the brahmins: / having cooked the flesh of fish, it concealed it with great quantities of rice.

16.29.s:
athovāca dvijānsarvānpraṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ viprā muhūrttaṃ mama sāṃpratam.. 41 ..
16.29.d:
अथोवाच द्विजान्सर्वान्प्रणिपत्य कृतांजलिः ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां विप्रा मुहूर्त्तं मम सांप्रतम्.. 41 ..
16.29.m: Then, having bowed down with joined palms, it spoke to all the twice-born: / 'Bestow your favor, O brahmins, upon me for a moment now!

16.29.s:
ātithyagrahaṇādeva dīnasya praṇatasya ca ..
yuṣmadarthaṃ mayā samyagetatpākaṃ samāvṛtam ..
kriyatāṃ bhojanaṃ bhūyo gaṃtavyamanu nākinām .. 42 ..
16.29.d:
आतिथ्यग्रहणादेव दीनस्य प्रणतस्य च ..
युष्मदर्थं मया सम्यगेतत्पाकं समावृतम् ..
क्रियतां भोजनं भूयो गंतव्यमनु नाकिनाम् .. 42 ..
16.29.m: Just by accepting hospitality from one who is humble and bowed down [you will do so]. / For your sake, this meal has been properly prepared by me. / Let the meal be eaten, and then you may go after the deities.'

16.29.s:
atha te brāhmaṇā matvā samudraṃ śraddhayānvitam ..
bāḍhamityeva taṃ procya bubhujuḥ svarṇabhājane .. 43 ..
16.29.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणा मत्वा समुद्रं श्रद्धयान्वितम् ..
बाढमित्येव तं प्रोच्य बुभुजुः स्वर्णभाजने .. 43 ..
16.29.m: Then those brahmins, believing the ocean to be full of faith / and saying to it, 'Very well,' ate from golden vessels.

16.29.s: na vyajānaṃta tanmāṃsaṃ guptaṃ svādu kṣudhārdditāḥ .. 44 ..
16.29.d: न व्यजानंत तन्मांसं गुप्तं स्वादु क्षुधार्द्दिताः .. 44 ..
16.29.m: Tormented by hunger, they did not recognize that hidden meat, which was delicious.

16.29.s:
tatastṛptāśca te viprā brāhmaṇā vigatakṣudhaḥ ..
āśīrvādaṃ daduḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsita vratāḥ .. 45 ..
16.29.d:
ततस्तृप्ताश्च ते विप्रा ब्राह्मणा विगतक्षुधः ..
आशीर्वादं ददुः सर्वे ब्राह्मणाः शंसित व्रताः .. 45 ..
16.29.m: Then, satisfied and freed from hunger, those wise brahmins, / all of praised vows, gave their blessing.

16.29.s:
bhojanāṃto brāhmaṇānāṃ prāṇāṃtaḥ kṣatrajanmanām ..
āśīviṣāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ kopo jñeyo mṛtāvadhiḥ ..
prerayāmāsa devānvai gamyatāmityuvāca tān ..46..
16.29.d:
भोजनांतो ब्राह्मणानां प्राणांतः क्षत्रजन्मनाम् ..
आशीविषाणां सर्पाणां कोपो ज्ञेयो मृतावधिः ..
प्रेरयामास देवान्वै गम्यतामित्युवाच तान् ..46..
16.29.m: [Saying,] 'Brahmins' [wrath] ends with food, kṣatriyas' [wrath] ends with life, / while the anger of venomous snakes is known to last until death,' / it spurred on the gods indeed, saying to them: 'Depart!'

16.29.s:
tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvā gacchaṃtaḥ śīghragā viyat ..
gacchatastāṃstato dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāstatra vaṃditā .. 47 ..
16.29.d:
ततो देवाः सगंधर्वा गच्छंतः शीघ्रगा वियत् ..
गच्छतस्तांस्ततो दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणास्तत्र वंदिता .. 47 ..
16.29.m: Then the gods, together with the gandharvas, went swiftly through the sky. / Seeing them going, the brahmins who had been saluted there

16.29.s: dakṣiṇārthaṃ samutpetuḥ surānuddiśya pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 48 ..
16.29.d: दक्षिणार्थं समुत्पेतुः सुरानुद्दिश्य पृष्ठतः .. 48 ..
16.29.m: flew up in pursuit of the gods for the sake of sacrificial gifts.

16.29.s:
tataḥ prapatitā bhūmau dvijāste sahasā punaḥ ..
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇātte vai brāhmaṇā māṃsabhakṣaṇāt.. 49 ..
16.29.d:
ततः प्रपतिता भूमौ द्विजास्ते सहसा पुनः ..
अभक्ष्यभक्षणात्ते वै ब्राह्मणा मांसभक्षणात्.. 49 ..
16.29.m: Then those twice-born fell suddenly down to the earth again, / indeed because of eating uneatable food, because of eating meat.

16.29.s:
niṣkṛtiṃ tāṃ parijñāya samudrasya ruṣānvitāḥ ..
daduḥ śāpaṃ mahādevi raudraṃ raudravapurddharāḥ .. 7.1.29.50 ..
16.29.d:
निष्कृतिं तां परिज्ञाय समुद्रस्य रुषान्विताः ..
ददुः शापं महादेवि रौद्रं रौद्रवपुर्द्धराः .. 7.1.29.50 ..
16.29.m: Realizing that deed of the ocean, filled with wrath, / assuming terrifying forms, they uttered a terrible curse, O great goddess:

16.29.s:
yasmādabhakṣyaṃ māṃsaṃ vai brāhmaṇānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam ..
tvayopahṛtamasmākaṃ suguptaṃ bhakṣyasaṃyutam .. 51 ..
16.29.d:
यस्मादभक्ष्यं मांसं वै ब्राह्मणानां परं स्मृतम् ..
त्वयोपहृतमस्माकं सुगुप्तं भक्ष्यसंयुतम् .. 51 ..
16.29.m: 'Since meat, which is strictly remembered as inedible for brahmins, / was served to us by you, well-hidden and mixed with edible food,

16.29.s:
ekataḥ sarvamāṃsāni matsyamāṃsaṃ tathaikataḥ ..
ekataḥ sarvapāpāni paradārāstathaikataḥ .. 52 ..
16.29.d:
एकतः सर्वमांसानि मत्स्यमांसं तथैकतः ..
एकतः सर्वपापानि परदारास्तथैकतः .. 52 ..
16.29.m: on one side are all meats, and the meat of fish on the other; / on one side are all sins, and another man's wife on the other!

16.29.s:
evaṃ vayaṃ vijānanto yadi māṃsasya dūṣaṇam ..
tathāpi vaṃcitāḥ sarve aparīkṣitakāriṇaḥ .. 53 ..
16.29.d:
एवं वयं विजानन्तो यदि मांसस्य दूषणम् ..
तथापि वंचिताः सर्वे अपरीक्षितकारिणः .. 53 ..
16.29.m: Even though we knew thus the fault of meat, / nevertheless we were all deceived, having acted without examination.

16.29.s:
yasmātpāpamate krūraṃ tvayā vai vañcitā vayam ..
māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāttasmādapeyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 54 ..
16.29.d:
यस्मात्पापमते क्रूरं त्वया वै वञ्चिता वयम् ..
मांसस्य भक्षणात्तस्मादपेयस्त्वं भविष्यसि .. 54 ..
16.29.m: Since we were deceived by you of sinful and cruel mind / into eating meat, therefore you shall become undrinkable!

16.29.s:
aspṛśyastvaṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ bhuvi ..
tavodakena ye marttyāḥ kariṣyaṃti kubuddhayaḥ .. 55 ..
16.29.d:
अस्पृश्यस्त्वं द्विजेंद्राणामन्येषां च नृणां भुवि ..
तवोदकेन ये मर्त्त्याः करिष्यंति कुबुद्धयः .. 55 ..
16.29.m: You shall be untouchable for the foremost of brahmins and for other men on earth. / Those mortals of evil intellect who, with your water,

16.29.s:
snānaṃ te narakaṃ ghoraṃ prayāsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ..
kṛtaghnānāṃ ca ye lokā ye lokāḥ pāpakarmiṇām .. 56 ..
16.29.d:
स्नानं ते नरकं घोरं प्रयास्यंति न संशयः ..
कृतघ्नानां च ये लोका ये लोकाः पापकर्मिणाम् .. 56 ..
16.29.m: perform a ritual ablution shall go to a dreadful hell, without a doubt. / And whatever realms belong to the ungrateful, whatever realms belong to evil-doers,

16.29.s: tāṃstavodaka saṃsparśāllapsyaṃte mānavā bhuvi .. 57 ..
16.29.d: तांस्तवोदक संस्पर्शाल्लप्स्यंते मानवा भुवि .. 57 ..
16.29.m: those will men on earth attain from touching your water!'

16.29.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śaptaḥ samudrastairbrāhmaṇairvaravarṇini ..
tato varṣasahasraṃ tu hyaspṛśyaḥ saṃbabhūva ha .. 58 ..
16.29.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं शप्तः समुद्रस्तैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वरवर्णिनि ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रं तु ह्यस्पृश्यः संबभूव ह .. 58 ..
16.29.m: Īśvara said: / "Cursed in this manner by those brahmins, O woman of excellent complexion, / it then became untouchable for a thousand years.

16.29.s:
tatastrāsākulo bhūtvā sarvāṃstānidamabravīt ..
devakāryamidaṃ viprā mayā kṛtamabuddhinā .. 59 ..
16.29.d:
ततस्त्रासाकुलो भूत्वा सर्वांस्तानिदमब्रवीत् ..
देवकार्यमिदं विप्रा मया कृतमबुद्धिना .. 59 ..
16.29.m: Then, overwhelmed with terror, it said this to them all: / 'This act of the gods was done by me without thought,

16.29.s:
bubhūṣatā paraṃ dharmaṃ śaraṇāgatasaṃbhavam ..
kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhādyastyajeccharaṇāgatam .. 7.1.29.60 ..
16.29.d:
बुभूषता परं धर्मं शरणागतसंभवम् ..
कामात्क्रोधाद्भयाल्लोभाद्यस्त्यजेच्छरणागतम् .. 7.1.29.60 ..
16.29.m: desiring the supreme dharma that arises from [protecting] one who has sought refuge. / He who, out of desire, anger, fear, or greed, abandons one who has sought refuge—'

16.29.s:
satyādvāpi sa vijñeyo mahāpātakakārakaḥ ..
yuṣmadbhītyā samāyātāḥ svargiṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama .. 61 ..
16.29.d:
सत्याद्वापि स विज्ञेयो महापातककारकः ..
युष्मद्भीत्या समायाताः स्वर्गिणः शरणं मम .. 61 ..
16.29.m: even if out of regard for truth, he should be known as one committing a great sin. / Out of fear of you, the gods of heaven came to me for refuge.

16.29.s:
te mayā rakṣitāḥ samyagyathāśaktyā hyupāyataḥ ..
śoṣayiṣye'hamātmānaṃ yasmācchaptaḥ prakopataḥ .. 62 ..
16.29.d:
ते मया रक्षिताः सम्यग्यथाशक्त्या ह्युपायतः ..
शोषयिष्येऽहमात्मानं यस्माच्छप्तः प्रकोपतः .. 62 ..
16.29.m: They were protected by me properly, to the best of my ability, by an expedient. / Since I have been cursed out of fierce anger, I shall dry myself up.

16.29.s:
bhavadbhirnotsahe sthātuṃ janasparśavinākṛtaḥ ..
evamuktvā tato devi samudraḥ saritāṃpatiḥ ..
ātmānaṃ śoṣayāmāsa duḥkhena mahatā sthitaḥ ..63..
16.29.d:
भवद्भिर्नोत्सहे स्थातुं जनस्पर्शविनाकृतः ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवि समुद्रः सरितांपतिः ..
आत्मानं शोषयामास दुःखेन महता स्थितः ..63..
16.29.m: "Deprived of the touch of human beings, I cannot bear to exist." / Having spoken thus, O Goddess, the ocean, the lord of rivers, / remaining in great sorrow, began to dry himself up.

16.29.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sthalākāraṃ mahārṇavam ..
śanaiḥśanaiḥ prapaśyaṃto bhayena mahatā'nvitāḥ .. 64 ..
16.29.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे स्थलाकारं महार्णवम् ..
शनैःशनैः प्रपश्यंतो भयेन महताऽन्विताः .. 64 ..
16.29.m: Then all the hosts of gods, seeing the great ocean / gradually taking the form of dry land, were seized with great fear.

16.29.s:
ūcurgatvā tu lokeśaṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham ..
asmatkṛte dvijaiḥ śaptaḥ sāgaro brāhmaṇottamaiḥ .. 65 ..
16.29.d:
ऊचुर्गत्वा तु लोकेशं देवदेवं पितामहम् ..
अस्मत्कृते द्विजैः शप्तः सागरो ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः .. 65 ..
16.29.m: Going to the lord of the world, the grandfather, the god of gods, they said: / "For our sake, the ocean was cursed by the twice-born, the best of brahmins.

16.29.s:
sa śoṣayati cātmānaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ ..
samudrājjalamādāya pravarṣaṃti balāhakāḥ .. 66 ..
16.29.d:
स शोषयति चात्मानं दुःखेन महतान्वितः ..
समुद्राज्जलमादाय प्रवर्षंति बलाहकाः .. 66 ..
16.29.m: Filled with great grief, he is drying himself up. / Taking water from the ocean, the clouds rain down.

16.29.s:
tataḥ saṃjāyate sasyaṃ sasyādyajñā bhavaṃti ca ..
yajñaiḥ saṃjāyate tṛptiḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām .. 67 ..
16.29.d:
ततः संजायते सस्यं सस्याद्यज्ञा भवंति च ..
यज्ञैः संजायते तृप्तिः सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम् .. 67 ..
16.29.m: From that grain is produced, and from grain sacrifices come to be; / by sacrifices satisfaction arises for all the dwellers of heaven.

16.29.s:
evaṃ tasya vināśena nāśo'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
tasmāttvaṃ rakṣa taṃ gatvā yathā śoṣaṃ na gacchati .. 68 ..
16.29.d:
एवं तस्य विनाशेन नाशोऽस्माकं भविष्यति ..
तस्मात्त्वं रक्ष तं गत्वा यथा शोषं न गच्छति .. 68 ..
16.29.m: Thus, by his destruction, our own destruction will occur. / Therefore, go and protect him, so that he does not dry up.

16.29.s: yathā tuṣyaṃti viprāste tathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 69 ..
16.29.d: यथा तुष्यंति विप्रास्ते तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 69 ..
16.29.m: Let a policy be devised such that those brahmins are pleased."

16.29.s:
devānāṃ vacanādbrahmā gatvā sāgarasannidhau ..
samudrārthe yayāce tānbrāhmaṇānkṣetravāsinaḥ .. 7.1.29.70 ..
16.29.d:
देवानां वचनाद्ब्रह्मा गत्वा सागरसन्निधौ ..
समुद्रार्थे ययाचे तान्ब्राह्मणान्क्षेत्रवासिनः .. 7.1.29.70 ..
16.29.m: At the word of the gods, Brahmā went into the presence of the ocean / and entreatied those brahmins dwelling in the sacred field on behalf of the ocean.

16.29.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāmasya sāgarasya dvijottamāḥ ..
yathā pavitratāṃ yāti madvākyātkriyatāṃ tathā .. 71 ..
16.29.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
प्रसादः क्रियतामस्य सागरस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यथा पवित्रतां याति मद्वाक्यात्क्रियतां तथा .. 71 ..
16.29.m: Brahmā said: / "O best of the twice-born, let favor be shown to this ocean! / Act in accordance with my word so that he attains purity.

16.29.s: pradāsyati sa yuṣmabhyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca .. 72 ..
16.29.d: प्रदास्यति स युष्मभ्यं रत्नानि विविधानि च .. 72 ..
16.29.m: He will give you jewels of various kinds.

16.29.s:
yūyaṃ bhaviṣyathātyaṃtaṃ bhūmidevā iti kṣitau ..
nāmnā madvacanānnūnaṃ satyametanmayoditam .. 73 .
16.29.d:
यूयं भविष्यथात्यंतं भूमिदेवा इति क्षितौ ..
नाम्ना मद्वचनान्नूनं सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 73 .
16.29.m: On earth you shall firmly become renowned as 'gods on earth' / by name through my word; this that I have spoken is indeed true."

16.29.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
nānyathā kartumicchāmastava vākyaṃ jagatpate ..
na ca mithyā''tmano vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ cātra vai bhavān .. 74 ..
16.29.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
नान्यथा कर्तुमिच्छामस्तव वाक्यं जगत्पते ..
न च मिथ्या'ऽत्मनो वाक्यं प्रमाणं चात्र वै भवान् .. 74 ..
16.29.m: The brahmins said: / "O Lord of the universe, we do not wish to set aside your word, / nor is our own word false; and you indeed are the authority here.

16.29.s:
tanno vākyātsuraśreṣṭha hitaṃ vā yadi vāhitam ..
paraṃ syājjagatāṃ śreyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām ..
tathā kuru jagannātha asmākaṃ hitakāraṇam .. 76 ..
athovāca nadīnāthaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
mā śoṣaya tvamātmānaṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me .. 76 ..
16.29.d:
तन्नो वाक्यात्सुरश्रेष्ठ हितं वा यदि वाहितम् ..
परं स्याज्जगतां श्रेयः सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम् ..
तथा कुरु जगन्नाथ अस्माकं हितकारणम् .. 76 ..
अथोवाच नदीनाथं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
मा शोषय त्वमात्मानं हितं वाक्यं शृणुष्व मे .. 76 ..
16.29.m:
Therefore, O best of gods, whether it be beneficial or harmful according to our word, / let there be the supreme welfare of the worlds and of all the heaven-dwellers. / Act in such a manner, O Lord of the universe, as to bring about our welfare."
Then Brahmā, the grandfather of the world, said to the lord of rivers: / "Do not dry yourself up; listen to my beneficial words.

16.29.s:
nānyathā śakyate karttuṃ dvijānāṃ vacanaṃ hi tat ..
brāhmaṇāḥ kupitā nūnaṃ bhasmīkuryuḥ svatejasā .. 77 ..
16.29.d:
नान्यथा शक्यते कर्त्तुं द्विजानां वचनं हि तत् ..
ब्राह्मणाः कुपिता नूनं भस्मीकुर्युः स्वतेजसा .. 77 ..
16.29.m: That word of the twice-born cannot indeed be undone. / If angered, the brahmins could surely reduce [the world] to ashes by their own splendor.

16.29.s:
devānkuryuradevāṃśca tasmāttānnaiva kopayet ..
yasmādeva tava sparśastridhā medhyo bhaviṣyati .. 78 ..
16.29.d:
देवान्कुर्युरदेवांश्च तस्मात्तान्नैव कोपयेत् ..
यस्मादेव तव स्पर्शस्त्रिधा मेध्यो भविष्यति .. 78 ..
16.29.m: They could turn gods into non-gods; therefore one should never anger them. / For this reason, contact with you shall be purifying in three ways:

16.29.s:
parvakāle ca saṃprāpte nadīnāṃ ca samāgame ..
setubaṃdhe tathā siṃdhau tīrtheṣvanyeṣu saṃyutaḥ .. 79 ..
16.29.d:
पर्वकाले च संप्राप्ते नदीनां च समागमे ..
सेतुबंधे तथा सिंधौ तीर्थेष्वन्येषु संयुतः .. 79 ..
16.29.m: when a festival time has arrived, at the confluence of rivers, / at the bridge [of Rāma], likewise at the Indus, and in connection with other sacred fords.

16.29.s:
ityevamādisarveṣu madhye'nyatra na karmaṇi ..
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ tava toyasya sparśādeva bhaviṣyati ..7.1.29.80..
16.29.d:
इत्येवमादिसर्वेषु मध्येऽन्यत्र न कर्मणि ..
यत्फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं तव तोयस्य स्पर्शादेव भविष्यति ..7.1.29.80..
16.29.m: In all such cases and the like, [your touch is purifying], but not in rituals at any other time. / Whatever fruit is obtained in all sacred fords, whatever fruit in all sacrifices, / that very fruit shall arise merely from touching your water.

16.29.s:
gayāśrāddhe tu yatpuṇyaṃ gograhe maraṇena ca ..
tatphalaṃ tava toyasya sparśādeva bhaviṣyati .. 81 ..
16.29.d:
गयाश्राद्धे तु यत्पुण्यं गोग्रहे मरणेन च ..
तत्फलं तव तोयस्य स्पर्शादेव भविष्यति .. 81 ..
16.29.m: Whatever merit lies in an ancestral offering at Gayā, or through dying in defense of cattle, / that very fruit shall arise merely from touching your water.

16.29.s:
apeyastvaṃ tathā bhāvi svādamātreṇa kevalam ..
gaṃḍūṣamapi pītaṃ ca toyasyāśubhanāśanam .. 82 ..
16.29.d:
अपेयस्त्वं तथा भावि स्वादमात्रेण केवलम् ..
गंडूषमपि पीतं च तोयस्याशुभनाशनम् .. 82 ..
16.29.m: You shall likewise be undrinkable merely by taste; / yet even a mouthful of water drunk destroys misfortune.

16.29.s:
bhaviṣyati nṛṇāṃ loke tava saukhyavivarddhanam ..
pitṝṇāṃ tava toyena yaḥ kariṣyati tarpaṇam ..
pūrvoktena vidhānena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 93 ..
yāvattvaṃ tiṣṭhase loke yāvaccadrārkatārakāḥ ..
tavodakāmṛtaistṛptāstāvatsthāsyaṃti pūrvajāḥ .. 84 ..
māghe māsi ca yaḥ snāyānnairaṃtaryeṇa bhāvitaḥ ..
pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ tasya divasedivase bhavet .. 89 ..
yātrāyāmathavānyatra parvakāle śaśigrahe ..
