16.35.s:
bāḍhamityeva coktvā sa praviṣṭo nidhimaṃbhasām..
evameṣā mahādevi prabhāse tu sarasvatī ..
gṛhītvā vāḍavaṃ prāptā tuṣṭyarthaṃ ca manīṣiṇām.. 101 ..
16.35.d:
बाढमित्येव चोक्त्वा स प्रविष्टो निधिमंभसाम्..
एवमेषा महादेवि प्रभासे तु सरस्वती ..
गृहीत्वा वाडवं प्राप्ता तुष्ट्यर्थं च मनीषिणाम्.. 101 ..
16.35.m: Saying ‘So be it!’, he entered the reservoir of waters. / Thus this Sarasvatī arrived at Prabhāsa taking the submarine fire, O great goddess, / for the satisfaction of the wise.

16.35.s:
sā viśrāṃtā kurukṣetre bhadrāvarte ca bhāmini ..
puṣkare śrīkalā devī prabhāse ca mahānadī .. 102 ..
16.35.d:
सा विश्रांता कुरुक्षेत्रे भद्रावर्ते च भामिनि ..
पुष्करे श्रीकला देवी प्रभासे च महानदी .. 102 ..
16.35.m: She rested at Kurukṣetra and at Bhadrāvarta, O passionate lady; / at Puṣkara, the goddess was Śrīkalā, and at Prabhāsa the great river.

16.35.s:
devamāteti sā tatra saṃsthitā lavaṇodadhau ..
asminmanvaṃtare devi ādau tretāyuge purā..103..
16.35.d:
देवमातेति सा तत्र संस्थिता लवणोदधौ ..
अस्मिन्मन्वंतरे देवि आदौ त्रेतायुगे पुरा..103..
16.35.m: She remained there in the salty ocean under the name Devamātā, / in this manvantara, O goddess, formerly in the beginning of the Tretā age.

16.35.s:
iti vṛttaṃ sarasvatyā vāḍavāgnestathābhavat ..
manvantare vyatīte'sminbhavitā'nyastu vāḍavaḥ .. 104 ..
16.35.d:
इति वृत्तं सरस्वत्या वाडवाग्नेस्तथाभवत् ..
मन्वन्तरे व्यतीतेऽस्मिन्भविताऽन्यस्तु वाडवः .. 104 ..
16.35.m: Thus occurred the history of Sarasvatī and of the submarine fire. / When this manvantara has passed, there will be another submarine fire;

16.35.s:
jvālāmukheti nāmnā vai rudrakrodhādbhaviṣyati ..
sarasvatyāstathā nāma khyātiṃ brāhmīti yāsyati .. 105 ..
16.35.d:
ज्वालामुखेति नाम्ना वै रुद्रक्रोधाद्भविष्यति ..
सरस्वत्यास्तथा नाम ख्यातिं ब्राह्मीति यास्यति .. 105 ..
16.35.m: it will arise indeed from Rudra's anger under the name Jvālāmukha, / and the name of Sarasvatī will attain renown as Brāhmī.

16.35.s:
sarasvatīti vai loke vartate nāma sāṃpratam ..
atītaṃ nāma yattasyāḥ kamaṃḍalubhaveti ca ..
ratnākareti sāmudraṃ satyaṃ nāmāṃtaraṃ purā .. 106 ..
16.35.d:
सरस्वतीति वै लोके वर्तते नाम सांप्रतम् ..
अतीतं नाम यत्तस्याः कमंडलुभवेति च ..
रत्नाकरेति सामुद्रं सत्यं नामांतरं पुरा .. 106 ..
16.35.m: Her name at present in the world is Sarasvatī; / her past name was Kamaṇḍalubhavā, / and the marine [name] was truly formerly Ratnākarā, another name.

16.35.s:
asminmanvaṃtare devi sāgareti prakīrtitam ..
kṣārodeti bhaviṣyaṃ tu nāma devi prakīrtitam .. 107 ..
16.35.d:
अस्मिन्मन्वंतरे देवि सागरेति प्रकीर्तितम् ..
क्षारोदेति भविष्यं तु नाम देवि प्रकीर्तितम् .. 107 ..
16.35.m: In this manvantara, O goddess, she is proclaimed as Sāgarā; / and Kṣārodā is proclaimed to be her future name, O goddess.

16.35.s:
evaṃ jānāti yaḥ kaścitsa tīrthaphalamaśnute ..
svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī .. 108 ..
16.35.d:
एवं जानाति यः कश्चित्स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ..
स्वर्गनिःश्रेणिसंभूता प्रभासे तु सरस्वती .. 108 ..
16.35.m: Whoever knows this thus enjoys the fruit of the sacred ford. / The Sarasvatī at Prabhāsa, born as a ladder to heaven,

16.35.s:
nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī ..
prācī sarasvatī devi sarvatra ca sudurlabhā ..
viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā .. 109 ..
16.35.d:
नापुण्यवद्भिः संप्राप्तुं पुंभिः शक्या महानदी ..
प्राची सरस्वती देवि सर्वत्र च सुदुर्लभा ..
विशेषेण कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रभासे पुष्करे तथा .. 109 ..
16.35.m: cannot be reached by men who lack merit. / The eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, O goddess, is exceedingly difficult to attain everywhere, / especially at Kurukṣetra, at Prabhāsa, and likewise at Puṣkara.”

16.35.s:
evaṃprabhāvā sā devī vaḍavānala dhāriṇī..
agnitīrthasamīpasthā sthitā devī sarasvatī .. 7.1.35.110 ..
16.35.d:
एवंप्रभावा सा देवी वडवानल धारिणी..
अग्नितीर्थसमीपस्था स्थिता देवी सरस्वती .. 7.1.35.110 ..
16.35.m: Such is the power of that goddess who carries the submarine fire. / The goddess Sarasvatī is stationed near Agnitīrtha.

16.35.s:
tāmādau pūjayedyastu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute ..
sāgaraṃ yacca tattīrthaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavarddhanam .. 111 ..
16.35.d:
तामादौ पूजयेद्यस्तु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ..
सागरं यच्च तत्तीर्थं पापघ्नं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् .. 111 ..
16.35.m: Whoever worships her first attains the fruit of the sacred ford. / And that sacred ford at the ocean destroys sin and increases merit.

16.35.s:
darśanādeva tasyaiva mahākratuphalaṃ labhet ..
agnicitkapilā satrī rājā bhikṣurmahodadhiḥ .. 112 ..
16.35.d:
दर्शनादेव तस्यैव महाक्रतुफलं लभेत् ..
अग्निचित्कपिला सत्री राजा भिक्षुर्महोदधिः .. 112 ..
16.35.m: Merely by seeing it, one obtains the fruit of a great sacrifice. / One who has piled the sacrificial fire, a Kapila cow, a performer of long sacrificial sessions, a king, a mendicant, and the great ocean—

16.35.s:
dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punaṃtyete tasmātpaśyeddhi bhāvitaḥ ..
agnitīrthe naraḥ snātvā pāvake prakṣipettataḥ ..
guggulaṃ bhārasahitaṃ sogniloke mahīyate .. 113 ..
16.35.d:
दृष्टमात्राः पुनंत्येते तस्मात्पश्येद्धि भावितः ..
अग्नितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पावके प्रक्षिपेत्ततः ..
गुग्गुलं भारसहितं सोग्निलोके महीयते .. 113 ..
16.35.m: These purify as soon as they are seen; therefore, full of devotion, one should behold them. / Having bathed in Agnitīrtha, a man should then throw into the fire / Bdellium resin weighing a bhāra; he is glorified in the world of Agni.

16.35.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ prokto hyagni tīrthamahodayaḥ ..
sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..114..
16.35.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो ह्यग्नि तीर्थमहोदयः ..
सरस्वत्याश्च माहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..114..
16.35.m: Thus the great eminence of Agnitīrtha has been related in brief, / As well as the māhātmya of Sarasvatī, which destroys all sins.

16.35.s:
snātvāgnitīrthe vidhivatkaṃkaṇaṃ prakṣipetataḥ ..
suvarṇasya mahādevi yathāvittānusārataḥ .. 115 ..
16.35.d:
स्नात्वाग्नितीर्थे विधिवत्कंकणं प्रक्षिपेततः ..
सुवर्णस्य महादेवि यथावित्तानुसारतः .. 115 ..
16.35.m: Having bathed duly in Agnitīrtha, one should then throw in a bracelet / Of gold, O great goddess, according to one's wealth.

16.35.s: tataḥ sarasvatīṃ pūjya kapardinamathārcayet .. 116 ..
16.35.d: ततः सरस्वतीं पूज्य कपर्दिनमथार्चयेत् .. 116 ..
16.35.m: Then, having worshipped Sarasvatī, one should revere Kapardin.

16.35.s:
tataḥ kedāranāmānaṃ bhīmeśvaramataḥparam ..
bhairaveśvaranāmānaṃ caṇḍīśvaramataḥ param.. 117 ..
16.35.d:
ततः केदारनामानं भीमेश्वरमतःपरम् ..
भैरवेश्वरनामानं चण्डीश्वरमतः परम्.. 117 ..
16.35.m: Then the one named Kedāra, and next Bhīmeśvara; / The one named Bhairaveśvara, and next Caṇḍīśvara.

16.35.s:
tataḥ someśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ ..
navagraheśvarāniṣṭvā rudraikādaśakaṃ tathā .. 118 ..
16.35.d:
ततः सोमेश्वरं देवं पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः ..
नवग्रहेश्वरानिष्ट्वा रुद्रैकादशकं तथा .. 118 ..
16.35.m: Then a man should duly worship the god Someśvara, / Having made offerings to the lords of the nine planets and to the eleven Rudras.

16.35.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam ..
evaṃ raudrī samākhyātā yātrā pātakanāśinī..119..
māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyā yo jānāti narottamaḥ..
nivasankṣetramadhye tu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute..7.1.35.12...
16.35.d:
ततः संपूजयेद्देवं ब्रह्माणं बालरूपिणम् ..
एवं रौद्री समाख्याता यात्रा पातकनाशिनी..119..
माहात्म्यमखिलं तस्या यो जानाति नरोत्तमः..
निवसन्क्षेत्रमध्ये तु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते..7.1.35.12...
16.35.m:
Then one should revere the god Brahmā in the form of a child. / In this way the pilgrimage sacred to Rudra, which destroys sins, has been declared.
Whichever best of men knows its entire māhātmya, / Dwelling within the sacred field, he attains the fruit of the sacred ford.

16.35.s: evaṃ kṛtvā tato gacchenmahādevīṃ sarasvatīm..121..
16.35.d: एवं कृत्वा ततो गच्छेन्महादेवीं सरस्वतीम्..121..
16.35.m: Having done this, one should then go to the great goddess Sarasvatī.

16.35.s:
sarasvatīvāsasamā kuto guṇāḥ sarasvatīvāsasamā kuto ratiḥ..
sarasvatīṃ prāpya divaṃ gatā narāḥ punaḥ smariṣyaṃti nadīṃ sarasvatīm.. 122 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetra māhātmye sarasvatyabdhisamāgamāgnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ..35..
16.35.d:
सरस्वतीवाससमा कुतो गुणाः सरस्वतीवाससमा कुतो रतिः..
सरस्वतीं प्राप्य दिवं गता नराः पुनः स्मरिष्यंति नदीं सरस्वतीम्.. 122 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्र माहात्म्ये सरस्वत्यब्धिसमागमाग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः..35..
16.35.m:
Whence are there virtues equal to dwelling by the Sarasvatī? Whence is there delight equal to dwelling by the Sarasvatī? / Men who have reached the Sarasvatī and gone to heaven will remember the river Sarasvatī again.
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Agnitīrtha and the Confluence of the Sarasvatī and the Ocean', in the First [sub-section], Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the Seventh Section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the gloriously sacred Skanda Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
